title: Salesforce Solution Architect (Healthcare or Health Cloud exp mandatory)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
Salesforce Industries is looking to expand our Professional Services Global Delivery Center team by hiring talented and enthusiastic Industry Solution Architects.
  
  
Salesforce Industries’ goal is to deliver rapid, value-driven customer solutions for complex business problems. Our Industry Solution Architects play a key role in determining the optimal use of the Vlocity product in the customer environment.
  
  
We are looking for industry experts who are passionate about the digital transformation of Health Domain and customer experience. Your responsibility is to understand the customer’s business requirements, design, and configure the desired solution.
  
  
This is a focused team of industry experts whose mission is to work with our largest and most important customers and implementation partners to deliver solutions that delight the customers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Effective in working with customers, including business executives, business analysts, and IT development staff
* Effective in understanding business needs and distilling the information into business and technical requirements
* Comfortable working with complex business requirements and translating into the design of solutions, including insurance product configuration, rate models, user stories, business rules, etc.
* Speed is paramount. This team is nimble and is the fulcrum to accelerate the delivery of the solution for customers.
* A collaborative and empathetic relationship with the business stakeholders will be central to your role. Your commitment to their success should never be in doubt.
* You’ll be a key channel back to the Salesforce Industries product management team as they look to drive innovation and improvements into future releases of Industry Cloud products.
* If you enjoy working with customers to help them succeed and thrive on working with leading-edge technologies, this is the role for you.
* This role will require travel to customer locations.

**Experience**

* At least 8+ years of Healthcare Industry Experience
* Involved in the Implementation of healthcare solutions at operators
* Demonstrated Ability in Healthcare domain or Health Cloud
* Engage business users to understand requirements and create solution designs
* Help in mapping business requirements to Salesforce Industry(SFI) Vlocity product functionality
* Identifies ‘What to implement’ in Vlocity CRM and ‘Solution’ level designs
* Able to evaluate the long-term impact of implementing a capability - Any conflict or limitations, impact on operations, roadmaps, or upgrades
* Knowledge of Salesforce Platform
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Collaborate with internal team members (sales/pre-sales, engineering, other services teams, etc.) to help customers increase the value of their Salesforce Industry products and services (Health Cloud)
* You will have a proven track record of successful delivery of customer projects, preferably enterprise CRM implementations for Telecom clients
* You will have direct experience in working with Salesforce (at an Admin level, minimum)
* You’ll be a self-starter, adept at picking up new skills and technologies, and eager to break new ground
* You’ll have excellent communication skills to communicate with customers, partners, and internal team members
* You’ll have the vision to help us take our company to the next level

**Technical Skills**

* Ability to technically lead complex projects throughout the complete IT lifecycle (Analysis, Architecture, Design, Build, Test & Production)
* Hands-On experience of
* Process modeling tools and best practices
* Project management tools and best practices
* Data modeling
* Systems analysis and design

**Desired Certifications/Qualification**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business or a related field
* Salesforce Sales/Service Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Administrator
* Salesforce Developer
* Certified Scrum Master / Certified Product Owner

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: ServiceNow Architect
description:
Join Verdantas – A Top #ENR 73 Firm,

We at Verdantas, looking for a
**ServiceNow Architect**
to lead platform architecture, enterprise integrations, and governance, delivering scalable and high-performing ServiceNow solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Architecture & Design**

* Own the end-to-end solution architecture across ServiceNow product lines (ITSM, ITOM, ITBM/SPM, HRSD, CSM, SecOps, as applicable).
* Define platform standards, design patterns, data models, and governance to ensure scalability, performance, security, and maintainability.
* Translate business requirements into robust technical designs and make build-vs-configure decisions that protect long-term platform health.

**Enterprise Integrations**

* Architect and oversee integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems (ERP, CMDB sources, HRIS, identity/SSO, monitoring, and third-party APIs).
* Design integration solutions using Integration Hub, REST/SOAP web services, MID Servers, event-driven patterns, and data-import strategies.
* Establish integration governance, error-handling, reconciliation, and security standards; ensure reliable, auditable data flows across the enterprise.
* Lead CMDB/CSDM design and data integrity strategy across integrated sources.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor a team of ServiceNow developers, admins, and consultants; set technical direction and uphold quality through design and code reviews.
* Own delivery quality across the SDLC — estimation, sprint planning, technical standards, and release management.
* Coach team members, grow platform capability, and manage technical dependencies across cross-functional stakeholders.
* Partner with product owners, business leaders, and vendors to align the platform roadmap with organizational priorities.

**Governance & Strategy**

* Chair the ServiceNow technical governance/CAB function; manage upgrades, technical debt, and instance strategy.
* Advise leadership on platform strategy, licensing implications, and emerging ServiceNow capabilities (including AI/Now Assist where relevant).

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or IT or degree in a relevant field
* 10+ years in enterprise IT, with 5+ years architecting and delivering ServiceNow solutions at scale.
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering
  **complex enterprise integrations**
  with ServiceNow (Integration Hub, REST/SOAP, MID Server, web services, event/messaging patterns).
* Proven experience
  **leading technical teams**
  and owning delivery quality across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Deep expertise in the ServiceNow platform: scripting (JavaScript, Glide), Flow Designer, Service Portal, ACLs/security, CMDB/CSDM, and performance optimization.
* Strong grasp of ITSM/ITIL processes and enterprise architecture principles.
* Excellent stakeholder communication — able to influence both engineers and executives.

**Certifications**

* ServiceNow
  **Certified Technical Architect (CTA)**
  strongly preferred (or Certified Master Architect).
* **Certified System Administrator (CSA)**
  required.
* One or more
  **Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS)**
  credentials (e.g., ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM).
* Integration Hub / relevant micro-certifications a plus.

**Preferred**

* Exposure to Agile delivery, DevOps for ServiceNow (CI/CD, automated testing/ATF), and multi-instance/global deployments.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms
  **(AWS/Azure/GCP)**
  and enterprise identity (SSO/SAML/OAuth).

**Location and Work Set-up**

* Pune, Maharashtra, India
* Work Mode: In Office

title: Gen AI
description:

**Dotnet Architect (Cloud)**

You will establish engineering standards and guide the delivery of secure, scalable and reliable platforms. * Conduct architecture assessments and detailed code reviews for mission-critical application components.Optimize system performance, scalability, reliability, resilience and cost efficiency
* Mentor senior developers and engineers while promoting technical excellence and continuous improvement.Partner with engineering teams, product managers and executive stakeholders to guide technical decisions

**What You Bring**
**Required Qualifications**

* 15+ years of software engineering experience, including three or more years in architecture or technical leadership
* Deep expertise in modern C++, including memory management, multithreading and low-level performance optimization
* Strong proficiency in .NET Core, .NET 6 or later, C#, Web API and microservices architecture
* Working knowledge of Java, Spring Boot and Angular frameworks for cross-technology integration. Demonstrated ability to design distributed, high-throughput, fault-tolerant enterprise systems
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, Docker, Kubernetes and continuous integration and delivery pipelines.Proficiency with relational and NoSQL technologies, including SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake and Redis

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Three to five years of experience in fintech, banking, trading, payments or wealth management technology

At FIS, we are as committed to growing our employees’ careers as our own business. We offer~
  
  

* Opportunities to innovate in fintech
* Inclusive and diverse team atmosphere
* Professional and personal development

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

title: Technical Architect
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title:**
Technical Architect
  
  
**Location:**
Pune | Hybrid / On-site
  
  
**Experience:**
12–15 Years
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Role Type:**
Horizontal Role – Cross-Domain | Independent Contributor | Hands-on Technical Expertise
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced Technical Architect to drive technical architecture and engineering excellence across four business sectors: Education, Commerce, Industrial, and Compliance.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in software design patterns, system architecture, distributed systems, and enterprise application development. The role requires the ability to independently lead complex technical initiatives from design through delivery and create detailed, actionable technical artifacts for engineering teams.
  
  
The candidate should be hands-on and capable of developing proof of concepts (PoCs), writing sample code, and validating architectural decisions whenever required. Experience with AI/ML systems, LLMs, and intelligent automation will be a significant added advantage.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Define and drive technical architecture across Education, Commerce, Industrial, and Compliance business domains.
* Independently lead technical design and execution of complex, cross-functional engineering projects.
* Create and maintain system context diagrams, architecture diagrams, data flows, database schemas, sequence diagrams, and API contracts.
* Define bounded contexts, integration patterns, and architectural standards for distributed systems and enterprise applications.
* Apply software design patterns, including creational, structural, and behavioral patterns, to build scalable and maintainable applications.
* Own non-functional requirements (NFRs), including scalability, performance, security, reliability, compliance, and extensibility.
* Develop technical proof of concepts, prototypes, sample implementations, and high-quality code to validate architectural decisions.
* Prepare and maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and detailed technical specifications.
* Review and approve technical designs, code, and pull requests to ensure architectural compliance.
* Identify cross-cutting concerns such as authentication, authorization, audit logging, and multi-tenancy, and define reusable solutions.
* Define architecture guardrails for latency, fault tolerance, data residency, auditability, and system reliability.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, engineering leads, and business stakeholders to translate product requirements into actionable technical solutions.
* Identify gaps between business objectives and existing technical capabilities and independently drive solutions.
* Evaluate APIs, data models, cloud infrastructure, and integration strategies across multiple product platforms.
* Assess AI/ML tools, LLMs, vector databases, RAG pipelines, and AI agents for potential enterprise integration.
* Provide technical guidance for intelligent search, automation pipelines, and AI-enabled product capabilities.
* Adapt to different technology environments and business domains while maintaining consistent architectural standards.

**QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIRED SKILLS**
**Technical Architecture & Design**

* 12–15 years of overall IT experience, with substantial experience in technical architecture and enterprise application design.
* Proven experience designing complex SaaS, B2B product ecosystems, and enterprise platforms.
* Deep understanding of software design patterns, enterprise integration patterns, and microservices architecture.
* Strong experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD), distributed systems, and system integration.
* Ability to independently drive large-scale architectural initiatives from inception to delivery.

**Programming & Development**

* Expert-level hands-on development experience in at least one of the following: .NET, Java, or PHP.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, SOLID principles, and clean code practices.
* Ability to develop working PoCs, prototypes, and sample implementations when required.
* Experience reviewing code and ensuring engineering quality and architectural consistency.

**API & Integration**

* Strong experience in REST APIs and API design.
* Knowledge of GraphQL, gRPC, and event-driven architecture.
* Experience designing enterprise integrations and communication patterns between distributed systems.

**Data Architecture**

* Strong understanding of relational, document, and graph data models.
* Experience designing database schemas, data flows, and integration models.
* Knowledge of data consistency, performance optimization, and data governance.

**Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP cloud architecture.
* Understanding of scalable, secure, highly available, and fault-tolerant systems.
* Experience with microservices, distributed infrastructure, and cloud-native design principles.

**Architecture Artifacts & Governance**

* Ability to create detailed technical specifications and implementation-ready design documents.
* Experience with UML diagrams, C4 models, sequence diagrams, system context diagrams, and API specifications.
* Experience authoring and maintaining Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
* Strong understanding of non-functional requirements and architecture governance.

**Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs)**

* Experience defining and enforcing requirements for performance, scalability, security, reliability, and extensibility.
* Understanding of authentication, authorization, multi-tenancy, auditability, data residency, and fault tolerance.
* Ability to identify architectural risks and establish appropriate technical guardrails.

**MANDATORY SKILLS**

* Technical Architecture and System Design
* Expert-level .NET, Java, or PHP development
* Software Design Patterns and SOLID Principles
* Microservices Architecture and Distributed Systems
* Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
* REST API Design and Enterprise Integrations
* Data Modeling and Database Architecture
* AWS / Azure / GCP
* Technical Documentation and Architecture Artifacts
* Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
* Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs)
* Hands-on PoC Development and Code Reviews

**GOOD TO HAVE SKILLS**

* AI/ML architecture and integration.
* LLMs, AI agents, and Generative AI.
* Vector databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Event-driven architecture and intelligent automation.
* GraphQL and gRPC.
* Multi-tenant SaaS platform architecture.
* Cloud-native technologies and infrastructure automation.
* Experience across Education, Commerce, Industrial, or Compliance domains.
* Knowledge of intelligent search, adaptive user experiences, and AI-enabled workflows.

**CROSS-DOMAIN BUSINESS CONTEXT**
**Education:**
Multi-tenant SaaS platforms, Learning Management System (LMS) integrations, identity federation, and campus data platforms.
  
  
**Commerce:**
Retail POS systems, event-driven inventory management, POS synchronization, and mobile data collection pipelines.
  
  
**Industrial:**
B2B e-commerce platforms, CRM data models, field service APIs, and pricing engine architecture.
  
  
**Compliance:**
Audit trails, regulatory data models, document versioning, accreditation workflows, and compliance-focused systems.
  
  
**About Sonata Software**
Sonata Software is an AI-first modernization engineering company that helps enterprises transform legacy systems into intelligent, scalable business platforms. Powered by its Platformation™ framework and Harmoni.AI platform, Sonata delivers AI-led modernization across cloud, data, AI, Dynamics, test automation, and managed services.
  
  
Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Sonata has more than $1.2 billion in revenue and 6,400+ AI engineers supporting global delivery across the US, UK, India, Malaysia, Mexico, Australia, DACH, and the Nordics. title: Power Platform Architect - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced Power Platform Architect to provide technical leadership for the Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Platform ecosystem within Vodafone’s Corporate AI Portfolio. This role will take ownership of the architecture, design, governance and delivery of AI-driven employee experiences, with an initial focus on AskHR, Vodafone’s global AI-powered HR assistant.
  
  
The successful candidate will work across Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, SAP and Google Cloud technologies to build scalable, secure and enterprise-grade conversational solutions. They will play a key role in advancing conversation-led employee experiences, establishing reusable AI and automation patterns, and accelerating digital transformation across HR, Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement and Legal functions.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Agent Architecture and AI Experience Design
  
  

* Architect, build and continuously enhance Microsoft Copilot Studio agents using generative orchestration, topics, tools, connected agents, triggers and multilingual capabilities
* Extend Microsoft 365 Copilot through declarative agents, plugins and connectors delivered through Microsoft Teams
* Design and implement conversation-led employee experiences using Agentic Conversation Designer principles
* Develop reusable AI agent frameworks that can be adopted across multiple corporate functions

Process Automation and Enterprise Integration
  
  

* Design and deliver end-to-end process automation solutions using Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Fx and Azure services
* Lead enterprise integrations with SAP SuccessFactors, SAP BTP, Integration Suite, OData services and REST APIs
* Enable employees to complete business transactions directly within conversational experiences
* Integrate ticketing platforms and live-agent hand-off capabilities where required
* Implement secure authentication, authorisation and identity solutions using Microsoft Graph and Microsoft Entra ID

Hybrid AI and Multi-Cloud Architecture
  
  

* Integrate Microsoft Copilot Studio with Google Cloud AI services, including Vertex AI Agent Builder and Gemini
* Establish hybrid knowledge architectures combining SharePoint-based knowledge with governed enterprise AI knowledge repositories
* Support interoperability using industry-standard protocols including MCP and A2A

Governance, Security and Operational Excellence
  
  

* Own Power Platform governance, environment strategy, solutions management, CI/CD pipelines and release processes
* Establish and maintain DLP policies, Managed Environments and Centre of Excellence practices
* Embed security, privacy and responsible AI principles throughout the solution lifecycle
* Implement monitoring and analytics using Copilot Studio Analytics and Application Insights
* Ensure highly available, scalable and reliable solutions that support a global workforce

Technical Leadership and Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to distributed development teams
* Define architecture standards, design principles and implementation best practices
* Conduct solution reviews, technical assessments and architecture governance activities
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, DevOps, SAP, Security and Enterprise Architecture teams
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft AI capabilities and make recommendations for adoption

Initial Focus Areas
  
  

* Take technical ownership of the Copilot Studio and Power Platform landscape supporting AskHR
* Remove technical delivery constraints across Microsoft Copilot and SAP-integrated solutions
* Define target-state architecture, standards and governance models
* Accelerate SAP-enabled employee journeys and validate hybrid knowledge architectures
* Support the evolution of AskHR into a fully conversation-led and agentic employee experience

**Who You Are**
Essential Skills and Experience
  
  

* Extensive experience in enterprise application architecture and integration, typically gained across complex, large-scale environments
* Significant hands-on experience as a Power Platform Architect or technical lead delivering production-grade solutions
* Deep expertise in Microsoft Copilot Studio, including generative AI and agentic capabilities
* Strong experience with Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Fx and Azure integration services
* Proven experience integrating SAP platforms and enterprise APIs
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, identity management and enterprise security practices
* Experience establishing and governing enterprise-scale Power Platform environments
* Practical understanding of generative AI concepts, including LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering and solution evaluation
* Hands-on software development experience using technologies such as C#/.NET, TypeScript, Python and Power Fx
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams, influence architectural decisions and mentor colleagues

**Desirable Skills And Experience**

* Experience with Google Cloud AI services, including Vertex AI, Agent Builder and Gemini
* Exposure to Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI services
* Microsoft certifications such as PL-600, PL-400, Copilot Studio or AI-related credentials
* Experience within HR, Finance, Supply Chain or Procurement domains
* Knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors and SAP S/4HANA environments
* Experience integrating ServiceNow or comparable IT service management platforms
* Experience delivering multilingual solutions across multiple regions and markets

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
Opportunity to shape the future of AI-powered employee experiences at global scale.Exposure to cutting-edge technologies across Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, SAP and Google Cloud ecosystems.Ability to influence enterprise architecture and AI strategy across multiple corporate functions.Work on high-visibility transformational programmes impacting employees globally.Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across Product, Engineering, AI, Architecture and Business domains.Opportunity to establish reusable AI and automation capabilities that create lasting business impact.Continuous exposure to emerging AI, automation and cloud technologies.
  
  
**What Skills You Will Learn**
Advanced agentic AI architecture and conversational experience design.Enterprise-scale Microsoft Copilot Studio implementation and governance practices.Hybrid AI architectures spanning Microsoft and Google Cloud platforms.Advanced SAP integration strategies within conversational AI ecosystems.Enterprise AI governance, responsible AI and security-by-design practices.Large-scale Power Platform ALM, DevOps and operational excellence frameworks.Cross-functional stakeholder management within global digital transformation programmes.
  
  
**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

title: Agentic AI Lead - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced Agentic AI Lead to drive the design, development and delivery of enterprise-scale agentic AI solutions across Vodafone’s Corporate AI Portfolio. This role will play a key part in shaping the future of AskHR, Vodafone’s AI-powered HR assistant, by defining agent architectures, advancing multi-agent orchestration across Google Cloud and Microsoft Copilot ecosystems, and creating reusable AI patterns for broader corporate functions. The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise with hands-on engineering leadership, enabling the delivery of secure, scalable and high-quality AI experiences that enhance employee productivity and experience globally.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Agentic AI Engineering
  
  

* Design, develop and deploy production-grade agentic AI solutions, ranging from single-agent implementations to complex multi-agent systems
* Implement advanced capabilities including tool and function calling, planning, memory management and agent orchestration
* Apply emerging interoperability standards such as Agent2Agent (A2A) and Model Context Protocol (MCP)

Architecture & Knowledge Management
  
  

* Evolve the AskHR AI architecture across Vertex AI Agent Builder, Agent Development Kit (ADK), Agent Engine and Gemini, integrating seamlessly with Microsoft Copilot Studio
* Drive improvements in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), grounding quality, chunking strategies, metadata filtering and enterprise knowledge retrieval
* Lead the transition from structured workflow-driven experiences to conversational, agent-led interactions

Quality, Security & Operations
  
  

* Establish robust evaluation frameworks, including offline evaluations, LLM-as-a-judge methodologies, regression testing and conversation analytics
* Implement observability frameworks, performance monitoring and cost optimisation strategies
* Embed responsible AI principles, privacy-by-design practices, GDPR compliance, prompt-injection protection and enterprise security controls
* Define and implement LLMOps practices and CI/CD processes for prompts, agents and knowledge pipelines

Technical Leadership
  
  

* Mentor and support engineers across multiple squads through code reviews, technical guidance and engineering standards
* Collaborate with architects, conversation designers, product owners and business stakeholders to align technical strategy with business objectives
* Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and industry developments

Initial Focus Areas
  
  

* Define and secure adoption of a target agentic architecture across HR, Google Cloud, Copilot Studio and SAP platforms
* Accelerate onboarding of HR journeys and knowledge sources through improved ingestion capabilities
* Deliver scalable content ingestion pipelines that significantly reduce onboarding time for new data sources
* Introduce evaluation-led release processes that improve answer quality and user containment rates
* Prototype innovative employee experiences and contribute to the FY28 AI roadmap

Broader Business Impact
  
  

* Develop reusable agentic AI components, accelerators and reference architectures for HR, Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Legal and other corporate domains
* Provide technical leadership across expanding AI portfolios and support the scaling of successful AI solutions throughout the organisation

**Who You Are**
Essential Skills & Experience
  
  

* Significant experience in senior software engineering, machine learning engineering or AI platform development, typically gained over 8+ years
* Proven hands-on experience delivering production-scale generative AI, LLM and agentic AI solutions
* Strong programming expertise in Python, with TypeScript experience considered advantageous
* Deep expertise in either Google Cloud AI technologies (Vertex AI, Agent Builder, ADK, Gemini) or Microsoft AI technologies (Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework), alongside working knowledge of the alternative ecosystem
* Strong understanding of RAG architectures, vector databases, API design and enterprise integrations
* Experience with cloud-native development, including containers, serverless platforms, infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices
* Expertise in AI evaluation methodologies, observability platforms and production AI monitoring
* Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and supporting the growth of engineering talent

**Desirable Skills & Experience**

* Experience delivering AI solutions within HR, Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement or other corporate functions
* Knowledge of SAP integrations, including SAP SuccessFactors and SAP BTP
* Experience with ServiceNow or comparable enterprise workflow platforms
* Exposure to multilingual conversational AI solutions, regulated environments and global deployments
* Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph or CrewAI
* Relevant Google Cloud or Microsoft certifications

**What's In It For You**
Opportunity to define and influence the future state of enterprise agentic AI architecture across a global organisation.Exposure to cutting-edge technologies spanning Google Cloud AI, Microsoft Copilot, Generative AI and multi-agent systems.Collaboration with global AI, architecture, HR and digital transformation teams.Opportunity to drive innovation through proof-of-concepts, experimentation and emerging technology adoption.Ability to create reusable solutions with impact across multiple business functions and global markets.Continuous learning within a rapidly evolving AI and cloud technology landscape.
  
  
**What Skills You Will Learn**
Advanced multi-agent architecture design and orchestration.Enterprise-scale implementation of Agent2Agent (A2A) and Model Context Protocol (MCP).AI governance, responsible AI frameworks and secure enterprise AI deployment practices.End-to-end LLMOps, AI observability and automated evaluation methodologies.Integration of AI agents across SAP, Copilot Studio, Google Cloud and enterprise platforms.Scalable knowledge management, RAG optimisation and conversational AI design techniques.Strategic technology planning and AI portfolio leadership.
  
  
**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

Defines and implements new automation and AI tooling, and evangelizes across the team.

Partner closely with product, business, and engineering teams to define requirements, shape roadmaps, and ensure solutions meet client and regulatory needs.

Produce high-quality design artifacts (architecture diagrams, sequence flows, APIs, data models) and maintain clear, traceable documentation.
  
  
Knowledgeable of emerging technologies and associated services.
  
  
Implement reference implementations, prototypes, and proof-of-concepts to de-risk assumptions and accelerate decision-making.
  
  
Write well-structured, testable, and efficient code where appropriate; set engineering quality bars for reliability, observability, and performance.
  
  
Establish and enforce non-functional requirements (availability, latency, throughput, recoverability), and define SLOs/SLIs with robust monitoring and alerting
  
  
Champion security-by-design and privacy-by-default principles—threat modeling, secure coding, data protection, encryption, and compliance alignment.
  
  
Drive integration strategies for legacy and modern systems (APIs, event streaming, messaging, microservices), ensuring interoperability and data integrity.
  
  
Guide CI/CD, DevOps, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices to streamline delivery, reduce risk, and improve release velocity.
  
  
Lead technical reviews (design, code, readiness) and provide constructive feedback to elevate engineering standards across teams.
  
  
Identify and remediate technical debt strategically—prioritize modernization efforts and build migration paths that minimize disruption.
  
  
Mentor and influence engineers without formal line management—uplift skills in architecture, design, testing, and operational excellence.
  
  
Expertise in architecting large-scale, distributed systems and producing high-fidelity design artifacts (diagrams, APIs, data models, migration plans). Proficiency in cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), containers and orchestration (Kubernetes), Infrastructure-as-Code, and CI/CD with strong testing, observability, and SRE practices. Strong integration and data skills across APIs, event streaming (e.g., Kafka), and governance, with security-by-design, privacy-by-default, and alignment to regulatory/compliance requirements.
  
  
Subject matter expert in at least one of the tools/technologies used in the space.
  
  
Executive-ready communication and influence without line management—driving technical strategy, risk management, vendor due diligence, and cross-functional alignment to measurable outcomes
  
  
Bachelor's degree in computer science engineering, information technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required
  
  
9-11 years of experience in software development or technology infrastructure engineering required; experience in the securities or financial services industry is a plus. Job holder must have understanding interdependencies and business impact of future IT plans. S/he must have prior lead experience selecting and implementing vendor-specific methodologies and prior consulting experience with structured methodologies. Extensive experience with developing and supporting mainframe applications required. Job holder must have broad experience with multi-platform development tools and toolkits.

title: dbt Cloud Solution Architect
description:
**Company Overview**
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management software.
  
  
**Position Overview**
You will lead the architecture and production evolution of the dbt Cloud and Snowflake transformation layer that supports data products, analytics, and AI use cases for Global Customer Success. Your primary charter is to make the platform more economical and scalable as data volume, complexity, and consumption grow. You will combine expert ELT pipeline design with hands-on dbt optimization, operational job monitoring, and production release practices.
  
  
This is not a documentation-only architecture role. You will investigate expensive or fragile workloads, design reusable patterns, implement foundational solutions, and help engineers run their daily work in dbt effectively. You will also establish the delivery controls to fully orchestrate bronze/silver/gold layers into downstream data use.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
You will make an impact by
  
  

* Own the technical architecture and engineering standards for dbt Cloud transformations on Snowflake, including project structure, model layering, dependencies, testing, documentation, orchestration, and deployment patterns.
* Reduce the marginal compute cost of roadmap growth by analyzing query and job behavior, identifying inefficient transformations, and prioritizing the optimizations with the highest return.
* Design efficient approaches for complex, high-volume datasets, including appropriate model boundaries, incremental processing, materialization strategies, workload sizing, scheduling, and reuse of transformed data.
* Establish production-grade DEV, QUA, and PRD dbt job processes with CI/CD controls, automated validation, release gates, regression detection, rollback approaches, and auditable release documentation.
* Define operational monitoring for dbt mart distribution of data products, working closely with data scientists, dashboard developers, and AI application owners to ensure outputs are meeting their needs.
* Coach dbt data engineers and collaborate with the wider data team through design reviews, code reviews, reusable examples, technical documentation, and knowledge transfer while remaining hands-on with complex implementations.

**Qualifications**

* Advanced, hands-on expertise with dbt Cloud in production environments. Deep dbt capability is a non-negotiable requirement for this role.
* Demonstrated experience designing, refactoring, and optimizing large dbt projects and complex SQL transformations on Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform.
* Strong knowledge of dbt model design, tests, macros, packages, documentation, lineage, orchestration, incremental models, snapshots, and materializations.
* Experience measuring and improving cloud data workload efficiency using query profiles, execution history, warehouse behavior, job telemetry, and cost or consumption data.
* Experience designing CI/CD and release-management practices for analytics engineering, including environment separation, automated checks, controlled promotion, regression handling, and rollback.
* Ability to translate business and data-product requirements into maintainable technical architecture and to communicate tradeoffs clearly across a global team.

**Preferred Skills**

* dbt certification or substantial evidence of advanced dbt practice.
* Expertise with managing Snowflake performance and cost optimization.
* Experience running transformations and data products for analytics, customer health, telemetry, or AI workloads.
* Experience establishing engineering standards in a growing data organization and establishing best practices.
* Familiarity with APIs, data contracts, semantic layers, metadata/catalog tools, and enterprise data governance.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Measurable reductions in normalized compute consumption, avoidable job runtime, and repeated transformation work.
* A documented and adopted set of reusable dbt patterns for efficient delivery.
* A functioning, controlled path from development through test to production, including regression and rollback practices.
* Improved reliability, observability, documentation, and maintainability of production dbt workloads.
* Greater internal dbt capability that can support a continuous increase in incoming requests and use cases.

**We are Siemens**
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
  
  
#SaaS
  
  
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: AI Product Engineer
description:
**Role Summary**

This role provides technical and delivery oversight across the IAIS (Industry AI Solutions) portfolio of AI / GenAI / Agentic AI solutions. The Product Engineering Lead assesses, solution by solution, whether each is being built as per the roadmap, at the expected quality, architecture and readiness, and then carries the best practices, reusable patterns and lessons from one solution to the others.

The role sits at the intersection of product, engineering and delivery. It works with IAIS Product Managers on what the roadmap commits to, with solution delivery teams and architects on how it is being built, and with program governance on how progress is reported. When a delivery team hits an operational or technical problem, this role brings the right expertise and the proven fix, so the team keeps moving.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Portfolio Review & Roadmap Conformance***

* **Review multiple IAIS solutions concurrently**
  through a structured review cadence (design, build-progress, release-readiness and post-release reviews), judging each against its roadmap commitments, scope, timelines and quality bar.
* **Detect drift early:**
  identify slippage, scope creep, architectural deviation, dependency gaps and technical debt, and agree corrective actions with the Product Manager and delivery lead.
* **Track portfolio health**
  through a consistent set of delivery and engineering KPIs (roadmap adherence, release predictability, quality and defect trends, incident and cost trends) and publish a portfolio view for program governance and senior stakeholders.

***Technical Assurance***

* **Assess solution architecture and engineering practice**
  for scalability, security, integration (including hyperscaler services), observability and maintainability.
* **Apply AI / Agentic AI readiness checkpoints**
  (evaluation metrics, guardrails and responsible-AI checks, quality gates, deployment and ops readiness) so that releases are repeatable and ship with confidence.
* **Review operational risk:**
  hallucination and quality issues, latency and token cost, data and integration failures, and production stability for solutions already live.

***Best-Practice Translation & Enablement***

* **Identify what works**
  in one solution (architecture patterns, evaluation approaches, prompt/agent design, LLMOps and CI/CD practices, accelerators) and translate it into reusable playbooks, reference architectures and standards for the other solutions.
* **Spread learning across teams**
  by running communities of practice, review forums and targeted coaching for delivery leads and engineers on GenAI / Agentic AI engineering and delivery.
* **Help teams solve operational problems**
  as and when they arise by pointing them to proven solutions, bringing in subject-matter experts, and capturing the resolution for the wider portfolio.

***Stakeholder & Team Leadership***

* **Work with IAIS Product Managers and delivery leads**

title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI)
description:
**Job Description**
Our Purpose
  
  
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Title and Summary
  
  
Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI)
  
  
**About The Team**
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We are currently looking for a Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) for the Operational Intelligence Program within the B&MI group. This role exists at the boundary between customer and product - /ou embed with clients before a single line of production code is written, validate whether an AI solution actually solves the business problem, and hand a scoped, evidence-backed brief to the product and engineering teams that build it. You are a builder first, but your deliverable is clarity, not code.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Embed directly with issuer and acquirer clients to understand their operational workflows, surface pain points, and identify where AI-driven automation or intelligence creates measurable business value.
* Design and build rapid proof-of-concept prototypes - agentic pipelines, conversational interfaces, analytical tools - scoped deliberately to test a specific business hypothesis, not to be production-ready.
* Translate ambiguous client requirements into concrete, testable problem statements; push back on requirements that are too broad to validate or too narrow to generalize.
* Run structured validation sessions with customers using working prototypes, gather qualitative and quantitative signal on whether the PoC addresses the stated need, and document what it does not.
* Synthesize field observations into product briefs: scoped requirements, edge cases discovered in the wild, constraints the platform team would not have known from a desk, and a clear go/no-go recommendation.
* Partner with product managers to ensure PoC findings directly inform roadmap decisions - requirements that survive validation become backlog items; those that do not get killed before investment is made.
* Maintain a working knowledge of the AI capability landscape (LLMs, agentic frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, structured data reasoning) broad enough to know what is feasible in a six-week PoC versus

what requires a platform build.
  
  

* Identify patterns across client engagements that suggest platform-level investment - repeatable needs that should become product features rather than one-off prototypes.
* Represent technical feasibility in pre-sales and discovery conversations; give customers and internal stakeholders an honest read on what AI can and cannot do for their specific workflow today.
* Mentor engineers and analysts on the team on customer discovery craft - how to ask questions that reveal unstated requirements, how to scope a PoC to answer one question well, and how to present findings without overselling.

**All About You**

* Master's or bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with significant experience delivering AI or data solutions to enterprise clients.
* Proven track record building working AI prototypes that directly influenced product or investment decisions - you can point to cases where your PoC changed what got built.
* Strong engineering foundation: you can write clean, working code quickly without over-engineering for production concerns that are irrelevant at the PoC stage.
* Fluent in Python and comfortable with SQL; experience with large-scale structured data and cloud data platforms is a strong plus.
* Hands-on experience with LLM APIs and agentic patterns - you understand the tradeoffs between what you can prompt, what you need to engineer, and what requires fine-tuning.
* Exceptional customer-facing communication: you can run a discovery session with a non-technical reconciliation analyst in the morning and write a technical scoping document in the afternoon.
* Strong product instinct: you can distinguish a business requirement from a solution assumption, and you know when a client is describing a symptom rather than a root cause.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity - you thrive when the problem statement is unclear and see scoping it as part of the job, not a blocker.
* Experience working in regulated industries (financial services, payments, healthcare) where data sensitivity, compliance constraints, and customer trust shape what can and cannot be prototyped.
* Track record of handing off well-scoped, evidence-backed briefs to product and engineering teams; you measure success by what gets built from your findings, not by the prototype itself.

Corporate Security Responsibility
  
  
**Responsibilities**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
**Overview**
Citi Treasury and Trade Solutions (TTS) is seeking a highly experienced and hands-on engineering leader to drive the architecture, development, and delivery of our next-generation Global Instant Payments Platform.
  
  
This role is ideal for an accomplished software engineer who enjoys solving complex distributed systems challenges, remains actively involved in architecture and technical design, and wants to build the future of real-time payment infrastructure at global scale. The successful candidate will combine deep payments expertise, low-latency Java engineering, cloud-native architecture, and strong delivery leadership to build resilient, high-performance payment solutions supporting Citi's global clients. The role requires close collaboration with Product, Operations, Infrastructure, Risk, and Engineering teams globally to deliver innovative, scalable, and secure instant payment capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of Citi's next-generation Instant Payments platform, providing hands-on technical leadership across the full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
* Design and develop high-performance payment services using Java, distributed systems principles, and event-driven architectures to support low-latency, real-time transaction processing at global scale.
* Drive the modernization of payment platforms on AWS through cloud-native architectures, microservices, APIs, containerization, and automated infrastructure practices.
* Build and evolve payment capabilities supporting RTP, FedNow, UPI, SEPA Instant, and emerging real-time payment networks across multiple markets and regulatory jurisdictions.
* Architect highly resilient and scalable systems capable of processing millions of transactions daily with demanding requirements for latency, availability, security, and operational resilience.
* Lead and mentor a team of engineers while remaining actively engaged in technical design reviews, architecture decisions, code quality, and resolution of complex engineering challenges.
* Partner with Product, Operations, Sales, and business stakeholders to translate client and market requirements into innovative payment capabilities and platform enhancements.
* Build and enhance core payment platform services including payment orchestration, liquidity management, reconciliation, settlement processing, transaction monitoring, exception management, and recovery capabilities.
* Champion engineering excellence through automated testing, CI/CD, observability, performance engineering, secure software development practices, and measurable quality outcomes.
* Leverage AI-enabled software engineering tools throughout the SDLC to improve developer productivity, code quality, testing effectiveness, platform reliability, and delivery velocity.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience building large-scale payment processing, transaction processing, or financial technology platforms.
* Expert-level Java development experience with deep understanding of concurrency, JVM performance tuning, asynchronous processing, low-latency application design, and distributed systems engineering.
* Proven experience designing and delivering high-throughput, mission-critical systems operating at enterprise scale.
* 5+ years of hands-on AWS experience building, deploying, and operating cloud-native applications in production environments.
* Strong expertise in microservices, event-driven architectures, REST APIs, messaging systems, and streaming technologies such as Kafka.
* Deep understanding of instant payments, payment processing, settlement, reconciliation, liquidity management, transaction lifecycle management, and payment operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams while maintaining hands-on involvement in architecture, technical design, and solution delivery.
* Strong experience with Agile delivery, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and production support.
* Experience leveraging AI-powered engineering tools and modern software development practices to accelerate development and improve engineering productivity.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical and business decisions across a global organization.
* Experience developing or operating platforms supporting RTP, FedNow, UPI, SEPA Instant, Faster Payments, Visa Direct, Mastercard Send, or similar real-time payment networks.
* Knowledge of global payment regulations, operational resiliency requirements, and financial services risk controls.

title: Sr. Engineer - Cloud
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
  
  
****About The Role:****
We're hiring a Senior Backend Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain SOAR connectors that integrate third-party security platforms with Falcon Fusion, and build/maintain platform services that provide core orchestration and workflow capabilities to all users of CrowdStrike's flagship Falcon Platform.
  
  
Falcon Fusion – a core 'tier one' offering in our Flagship Platform, Falcon – is the Falcon product used by customers to automate breach remediations within their environments. It also serves as the runtime of apps built by our Foundry Module, and is 'dogfooded' by us internally to automate other workflows and speed up development. With these many varied uses, it can be responsible for processing anywhere from 500M to 10B+ events/day and is in use by essentially every single customer of the Falcon Platform.
  
  
This role is for an experienced backend microservices developer adept with cloud engineering principles. Your passion and meticulous attention to performance, reliability and scalability will be key ingredients to your success here at CrowdStrike.
  
  
****What You'll Do:****

* Build production-grade SOAR connectors that integrate security platforms (SIEM, EDR, ticketing, IAM) with Falcon Fusion at scale, and contribute to the core platform services that power connector execution, authentication, and orchestration.
* Drive architectural decisions for connector platform design, evaluating tradeoffs between scalability,reliability, and developer experience
* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on distributed systems design, authentication protocols, and production operations best practices
* You'll own connectors end-to-end—from API research through deployment and production support—while improving the platform capabilities (auth systems, testing frameworks, deployment pipelines) that all connectors depend on
* Research, evaluate, and integrate new security platforms and APIs to expand our connector portfolio
* Develop both connectors and platform services, working with authentication mechanisms (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, API keys) at both the connector and platform layer
* Build and maintain automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines that ensure connector quality and reliability across multi-region deployments
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues with existing connectors and platform services, taking operational ownership of incidents across our fleet of Falcon environments
* Write technical documentation including integration guides, API specifications, and troubleshooting runbooks

****What You'll Need:****

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent work experience
* 10+ years of experience designing, implementing, and maintaining multiple software products/systems/releases, preferably in a SaaS delivery model, across all phases of the development lifecycle
* Fluency in at least one programming language, preferably in Python or Go
* Proven expertise in building distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs
* Experience developing applications using SQL and NoSQL databases
* Deep expertise in building distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs with a track record of making architectural decisions at scale
* Hands-on experience in large-scale (distributed) system architecture, high scalability and availability, and optimization
* Strong debugging skills
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
* Demonstrated track record of operational excellence when operating services that span many components across several geographical regions
* Strong communication skills; working collaboratively and confidently with internal stakeholders

****Bonus Points:****

* Experience with commercial clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Contributions to the open source community

title: Snowflake Data Platform Architect
description:

Snowflake Data Platform Architect will own the architecture, design, and modernization of Riveron’s enterprise data foundation. This role will be responsible for building scalable, governed, and AI-ready data infrastructure across Snowflake, Power BI (Microsoft Fabric experience a plus), Salesforce, Alteryx migration, APIs, and shared data access patterns.
  
  
This role is central to Riveron’s future-state data strategy. The person should be both a hands-on architect and a platform owner who can create durable enterprise patterns rather than one-off reporting solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the architecture and technical roadmap for Riveron’s enterprise data platform.
* Lead Snowflake datawarehouse / lakehouse design, including data modeling, ingestion, transformation, access controls, performance tuning, and cost optimization.
* Design reusable data models, semantic layers, and governed datasets for enterprise reporting and AI-enabled use cases.
* Partner with reporting and analytics teams to modernize Power BI models (Microsoft Fabric experience a plus) and reduce dependency on manual or fragmented reporting processes.
* Support Alteryx modernization and migration where appropriate, replacing manual workflows with scalable data pipelines.
* Design data integration patterns across Salesforce, SharePoint / Microsoft 365, finance systems, operational platforms, spreadsheets, APIs, and third-party data sources.
* Establish data quality, lineage, reconciliation, documentation, and observability standards.
* Partner with AI product engineers to make Riveron’s data architecture AI-ready for pilots, agents, retrieval-augmented generation, and natural language analytics.
* Provide technical leadership to data engineers, BI developers, analysts, and AI engineers.

**Required Experience**

* 6-9 years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, cloud data platforms, or analytics engineering.
* Deep hands-on experience with Snowflake, SQL, data modeling, ELT / ETL, and enterprise data warehouse design.
* Experience with Power BI semantic models required; Microsoft Fabric or similar enterprise BI platform experience a plus but not required.
* Strong understanding of data governance, security, role-based access, data quality, and lifecycle management.
* Experience integrating data from SaaS platforms, APIs, finance systems, Salesforce, and flat-file sources.
* Ability to design scalable architecture while still contributing hands-on when needed.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with SQL, Python, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Fivetran, Matillion, or similar tools.
* Experience modernizing Alteryx or spreadsheet-heavy processes.
* Exposure to AI / ML data readiness, vector databases, semantic search, RAG architecture, or LLM application patterns.

title: Sr. Martech Enterprise System Engineer
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
Avalara's Marketing Technology team is scaling its execution capabilities and expanding its AI capabilities to keep pace with a growing go-to-market engine. The systems that power campaign execution, lead lifecycle management, and marketing operations, Workfront, Marketo, and our leads pipeline, require strong, hands-on technical talent to build, maintain, and continuously improve them.
  
  
This IC4 MarTech Engineer role is for a strong technical leader who can transition marketing capabilities from a digital marketing paradigm to an agentic marketing approach by integrating, automating, and configuring new agentic models and solutions across our enterprise capabilities, building reliable integrations, automating marketing workflows, and ensuring lead data flows accurately from capture to CRM handoff.
  
  
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**

* Build and maintain integrations between Marketo, Salesforce CRM, Workfront, and adjacent MarTech systems, delivering reliable, well-documented solutions.
* Engineer and optimize the lead lifecycle from capture and enrichment through scoring, routing, and CRM handoff, reducing lead leakage and improving data accuracy across the pipeline.
* Develop and maintain automation for campaign operations, asset management workflows in Workfront, and lead management processes in Marketo, replacing manual effort with reliable, auditable automation.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions by working closely with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, and Sales Operations to understand needs and deliver working solutions on time.
* Troubleshoot and resolve platform issues across Workfront, Marketo, and the leads pipeline, performing root cause analysis and implementing fixes that prevent recurrence.
* Write clean, maintainable code and configurations following team standards for API design, data handling, error management, and security best practices.
* Contribute to technical documentation by keeping integration maps, data flow diagrams, and runbooks current so the team can operate and onboard efficiently.
* Support peers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and hands-on collaboration, raising the technical quality of the team's output.
* Monitor platform health and proactively flag performance issues, data anomalies, or integration failures before they impact marketing operations

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**Qualifications**

* B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in marketing technology, enterprise systems engineering, or a closely related technical discipline have recent hands-on work building AI/ML systems
* Solid hands-on experience with Marketo, including program setup, smart list logic, API integrations, lead lifecycle configuration, and data management.
* Hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront, including workflow configuration, template management, and automation for marketing or creative operations.
* Experience building and maintaining lead management pipelines, including capture, enrichment, deduplication, and scoring.
* Demonstrated production experience with LLMs, RAG pipelines, vector search/embeddings, or recommendation systems — not prototypes, but systems that served real traffic
* Proficiency in Python, SQL, and JavaScript/Node.js, with experience owning AWS Lambda data pipelines from design to deployment.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and modern ML tooling (e.g., MLflow, SageMaker, or equivalents)

**Bar Raiser Expectations**
This role is a Bar Raiser hire. The successful candidate will:
  
  

* Hold themselves and others to high standards of technical quality, data integrity, and operational accountability
* Demonstrate strong judgment when making platform and technical tradeoffs, especially those that affect campaign performance, lead data quality, or system reliability.
* Raise the performance of those around them through mentorship, rigorous code reviews, and clear documentation.
* Simplify complexity, translating ambiguous marketing requirements into clean, maintainable technical solutions.
* Challenge assumptions respectfully and bring data into technical decisions.
* Leave every system, process, and team they touch stronger than they found it.

**AI Expectations**
Avalara is an AI-first company. This role is expected to be an
**AI Bar Raiser**
, not a casual user of AI tools, but someone who embeds AI into how MarTech work gets done and elevates the AI capability of the team.
  
  
**Specifically, This Role Is Expected To**

* Use AI to accelerate development and troubleshooting, including AI-assisted code generation, API debugging, and automated testing for MarTech integrations.
* Apply AI to lead intelligence, leveraging AI/ML-based lead scoring and intent signal processing to improve pipeline quality and Sales efficiency.
* Automate content and campaign operations using AI tools to reduce manual effort in asset creation, QA, and campaign setup within Marketo and Workfront.
* Identify and quantify AI-driven improvements, e.g., reduction in lead processing time, improvement in MQL-to-SQL conversion, or hours saved through intelligent workflow automation.
* Share AI best practices with the MarTech team and Marketing Operations, helping peers adopt AI tools responsibly and effectively.
* Apply AI responsibly, with awareness of data privacy, governance, and ethical use standards relevant to marketing data and customer information.

Candidates who cannot demonstrate specific, measurable AI impact in prior roles do not meet Avalara's AI Bar Raiser standard.
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.
