title: Distinguished Engineer – Secure Private Access (SPA) / Zero Trust
description:
**SonicWall**
 is a cybersecurity forerunner with more than 30 years of expertise and is recognized as a leading partner-first company, ensuring our partners and their customers are never alone in the fight against cybercrime. With the ability to build, scale and manage security across the cloud, hybrid and traditional environments in real-time, SonicWall provides relentless security against the most evasive cyberattacks across endless exposure points for increasingly remote, mobile and cloud-enabled users. With its own threat research center, SonicWall can quickly and economically provide purpose-built security solutions to enable any organization—enterprise, government agencies and SMBs—around the world. For more information, visit 
**www.sonicwall.com**
 or follow us on 
**Twitter**
, 
**LinkedIn**
, 
**Facebook**
 and 
**Instagram**
.

**Role Overview**

SonicWall is seeking a
**Distinguished Engineer**
to define and drive the long-term technical vision, architecture, and evolution of its
**Secure Private Access (SPA)**
platform and Zero Trust access technologies. This role serves as the highest level of individual contributor leadership, influencing architecture, engineering strategy, and innovation across multiple product and engineering organizations. The role builds upon SonicWall's current cloud-native SSE, ZTNA, and secure access initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and drive the long-term technical vision and architecture strategy for SonicWall's Secure Private Access (SPA) platform and Zero Trust access technologies.
* Lead the design and evolution of highly scalable, secure, resilient, cloud-native distributed systems.
* Influence technical direction, architectural decisions, and engineering standards across multiple product and engineering organizations.
* Provide technical leadership during critical production incidents, customer escalations, and security events, driving root cause analysis and long-term architectural improvements.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to engineering and executive leadership.
* Mentor Principal Engineers and cultivate technical leadership across the organization.
* Champion AI-first engineering practices to improve productivity, quality, and innovation.

**Required Qualifications**

* 15 -18+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical leadership in large-scale infrastructure, networking, or security platforms.
* Proven track record of hands-on contributions to complex distributed systems and cloud-scale services.
* Deep expertise in networking and traffic processing technologies, including data plane architectures, TCP/IP, DNS, WireGuard, and cloud-oriented Layer 3/4/7 access enforcement strategies.
* Strong programming experience in Go, C++, Rust, or similar systems languages.
* Deep understanding of networking and security fundamentals, including authentication, authorization, encryption, and identity systems.
* Expertise in one or more domains: Secure Private Access (SPA), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Secure Service Edge (SSE), SASE, VPN/secure connectivity, and enterprise access security platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to influence engineering strategy across organizations without direct authority.
* Strong track record of mentoring senior engineers and driving impactful technology decisions.
* Expertise in AI-enabled software engineering and platform modernization.
* Strong customer obsession with the ability to translate customer requirements, operational learnings, and market needs into platform and architectural investments.
* Extensive experience leading the response and resolution of large-scale production incidents, customer escalations, and security events, including executive communication, root cause analysis, and implementation of long-term corrective action

**Success Measures**

* Establish and drive adoption of a clear architectural vision for SonicWall's Secure Private Access platform.
* Deliver the next generation of SPA capabilities and technical differentiation.
* Influence the evolution of SonicWall's Zero Trust and secure access portfolio.
* Improve platform scalability, reliability, performance, and operational efficiency.
* Reduce customer-impacting incidents through proactive architectural improvements, operational rigor, and continuous learning from production events.
* Elevate technical leadership through mentorship, engineering standards, and architectural excellence.

SonicWall is an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.
  
  
At SonicWall, we pride ourselves on recruiting a diverse mix of talented people and providing active security solutions in 100+ countries.

title: Chief AI Architect
description:
Position Summary
  
  
The Chief AI Architect (CAIA) serves as the enterprise design authority for artificial intelligence at STERIS and leads the AI Center of Excellence (AI CoE) delivery organization, owning AI and agentic-AI architecture standards, solution reusability, technical-debt governance, and model/platform strategy end-to-end from proof-of-concept through production. Reporting to the Vice President & Chief Information Officer, the CAIA converts validated AI proof-of-concept value into governed, production-grade AI capability that supports the company growth strategy while managing regulatory and quality risk. As a peer to the Chief Enterprise Architect, the CAIA owns AI solution architecture, model strategy, and agentic-AI build decisions, while the Chief Enterprise Architect retains enterprise AI governance, policy, and audit-readiness oversight through the Architecture Review Board. The CAIA leads the AI CoE’s delivery pods (Product Management, POC, Development, and Operations) and drives a prioritized, value-scored AI project pipeline.
  
  
Duties
  
  

* AI CoE delivery leadership (20%). Lead the AI Center of Excellence delivery organization (Delivery Lead, AI Product Management, POC “Factory,” Development, and AI Command Center/Operations pods); sustain a governed, prioritized pipeline of active AI projects from proof-of-concept through production.
* AI production operations (10%). Own monitoring, drift detection, and incident response for live AI workloads (est. 8–12 today); ensure production AI meets enterprise reliability, security, and quality standards.
* Responsible-AI execution & governance partnership (10%). Partner with the Chief Enterprise Architect and AI Governance Steering Committee/Review Board to execute human-in-the-loop, fail-closed controls at the solution level; build to EU AI Act, FDA CSV/CSA (GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11) requirements as directed by governance.
* Demand pipeline & business translation (10%). Direct AI Product Managers in translating business challenges into a prioritized, value-scored backlog; serve as the technical counterpart to business stakeholders on use-case feasibility and value.
* Data & AI platform partnership (8%). Partner with the Director, Data Engineering & Platform and Director, Data Governance & Management to ensure AI solutions run on trusted, governed data foundations.
* Talent, training & AI adoption (7%). Support the AI Enablement & Adoption Lead and AI Academy/Community programs; mentor AI Development and POC talent; build the CoE succession plan.
* Consultant-to-FTE transition & vendor management (10%). Own the transition of AI delivery from SOW-based consulting to a permanent, budgeted FTE organization; partner with Procurement and HR on hiring, onboarding, and AI tooling vendor consolidation.
* Leadership: Provides strategic leadership and direction for the function, leading and developing high-performing teams, driving organizational priorities, fostering a culture of accountability and collaboration, and ensuring the successful execution of business objectives aligned with the company's long-term goals.

Duties - cont'd
  
  
Education Degree
  
  
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or Engineering General
  
  
**Required Experience**

* 15 overall years of experience including: 8+ years in technology, 4+ years in AI/ML, data science, or enterprise architecture roles, and 2+ years leading an AI delivery function or team.
* Demonstrated production delivery of AI/GenAI solutions at enterprise scale; proven ability to convert proof-of-concept work into governed, production-grade capability.
* Experience standing up or scaling an AI Center of Excellence or comparable delivery organization.
* Regulated-industry experience (medical device, life sciences, healthcare, or similar) preferred; familiarity with FDA CSV/CSA (GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11), EU AI Act, and data-privacy (GDPR) obligations a plus.
* Progressive technology leadership experience
* Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams of AI professionals preferably for roles that support development and an AI Command Center/Operations.
* AI/GenAI and agentic-AI architecture, model strategy, and platform evaluation (e.g., Azure AI Foundry, Claude, Copilot).
* MLOps, production AI monitoring, drift detection, and incident response.
* Delivery organization leadership: pipeline management, resourcing, and pod-based delivery models (POC, development, operations).
* Executive stakeholder management and business translation (value-scoring, backlog prioritization).
* Team building, mentoring, and succession planning for a technical delivery organization
* Demonstrated success defining and executing enterprise-wide AI strategies aligned with business objectives and digital transformation goals.
* Experience influencing C-suite executives and senior business leaders on AI investments, innovation roadmaps, and technology strategy.
* Strong track record of building high-performing teams through coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and talent development.
* Proven leadership in driving organizational change and fostering AI adoption across business functions.

title: Technical Design Lead for Salesforce Field Service Management
description:
Founded in 1910, KONE is a global leader that provides elevators, escalators and automatic building doors, as well as solutions for maintenance and modernization that add value to buildings throughout their life cycle. Our mission is to improve the flow of urban life and make our world’s cities better places to live by providing innovative solutions that help make people’s journeys safe, convenient and reliable. Our operations in over 60 countries around the world has helped us achieve our position as an innovation and sustainability leader with repeated recognitions by Forbes, Corporate Knights for clean capitalism and others.
  
  
KONE’s vision is to create the Best People Flow experience by providing ease, effectiveness and experience to our customers and users. In line with our strategy, Sustainable Success with Customers, we will focus on increasing the value we create for customers with new intelligent solutions and embed sustainability even deeper across all of our operations. By closer collaboration with customers and partners, KONE will increase the speed of bringing new services and solutions to the market.
  
  
**KONE Technology and Innovation Unit (KTI)**
is where we combine the physical world – escalators and elevators – with smart and connected digital systems. We are changing and improving the way billions of people move within buildings every day. We are on a mission to expand and develop new digital solutions that are based on emerging technologies.
  
  
**KONE IT**
is a global team of expert professionals working along with business functions and area teams to develop new capabilities and enable new business opportunities. We are trusted partners of KONE business lines and functions to develop, transform, manage and run their information technology solutions. We support KONE in its digital transformation journey by introducing e.g. digital cloud-based IT services, artificial intelligence (AI) and automation to support productivity, business growth and technological disruption.  Sustainability, curious mindset and innovation are at the core of everything we do, and this makes us an integral part of KONE’s success.
  
  
You will own the architecture, technical design, configuration, development and design related to our Field Service Management solution (FSM). KONE was the first company in the world to partner with Salesforce on the Field Service Management, and through that co-creation FSM entity is built on top of Salesforce Field Service Lightning solution, combined with custom built mobile experience for tens of thousands of field technicians.
  
  
As the Technical Design Lead you will lead and guide internal and external teams in developing and implementing FSM. You are responsible for establishing guidelines and processes, as well as validating and approving all designs. You will work closely also with Product Owners and Enterprise Architects to drive solution architecture, enabling high performance, maintainability, scalability and security.
  
  
Main Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the technical design and solution both for FSM Core and FSM Mobile
* Own the solution functionality design as per approved demands, and translate those to IT functional and technical requirements
* Defines the optimal configuration with maximal utilization of out-of-the-box functionality vs KONE-specific customization
* Support in defining data model and controlling data integrity for the solutions
* Support application support teams and KONE service management in problem management
* Support FSM license management
* Ensure that solution development is in line with business objectives, user needs, target architecture and IT standards & frameworks
* Ensure the solution documentation is always up-to-date
* Understand the FSM solution big-picture and the target state and it’s role in IT landscape and service business processes.

The desired candidate will have
  
  

* M.Sc. degree or equivalent
* Professional experience of minimum 12 years in IT industry, with at least 8 years in Salesforce
* Expertise and hands on experience in Salesforce Field Service Lightning and Service Cloud products and their implementation
* Expertise and hands on experience in custom mobile architectures
* Good knowledge of handling & simplifying Salesforce data integration designs with backend systems like SAP, IoT etc.
* Salesforce App Builder and Developer certification(s). Other Salesforce certification(s) are an added advantage
* Demonstrated track record of clear achievements from previous positions held
* Experience in leadership and matrix organizations
* Experience with supplier collaboration / collaboration with development partners
* Experience in working in international environment with stakeholders distributed globally
* Excellent stakeholders’ communication skills (both written and oral)
* Excellent change management, analysis and problem solving skills
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills in English

*At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life.*
Read more on
*https://kone.com/global/en/careers.html*

description:
**Job Description**
**Databricks Champion -Data Architect**
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced
***Data Architect – Databricks Champion recognition***
to provide architecture and technical leadership for enterprise-scale data platforms built on Azure Databricks and Lakehouse architecture. Need to have.
  
  
The candidate should combine strong architectural expertise with hands-on data engineering experience and be capable of translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, governed and high-performance data solutions. The role will work closely with Data Architects, Data Engineers, Analytics teams and business stakeholders while mentoring engineering teams and establishing Databricks architecture and development best practices.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect and lead enterprise-scale Azure Databricks Lakehouse solutions.
* Design scalable Bronze, Silver and Gold architectures for ingestion, transformation, integration and data consumption.
* Lead complex ETL/ELT, data migration and modernization initiatives across multiple source systems and business domains.
* Define reusable architecture patterns, engineering standards and frameworks using Databricks, Spark, PySpark, SQL and Delta Lake.
* Design and review analytical and dimensional data models, including Fact/Dimension and Star Schema models.
* Drive performance optimization of Spark workloads, SQL queries and data pipelines.
* Establish standards for data quality, governance, metadata, lineage, security, monitoring and access management.
* Define engineering practices around Git, CI/CD, automated deployment and code quality.
* Conduct architecture/design reviews and provide hands-on technical guidance to Data Engineers.
* Mentor engineering teams and collaborate with senior business and technical stakeholders on solution design, technical dependencies and risks.

**Technical Skills & Certifications - Essential Skills**

* 10–15 years of experience in Data Engineering/Data Architecture.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Azure Databricks and Lakehouse architecture.
* Advanced skills in Apache Spark, PySpark, Python, SQL and Delta Lake.
* Strong understanding of Bronze/Silver/Gold architecture and enterprise ETL/ELT patterns.
* Experience with batch/incremental processing, schema evolution and large-scale data pipelines.
* Experience with AI/ML, Generative AI, and Databricks Mosaic AI.
* Strong knowledge of dimensional modelling, Fact/Dimension modelling and Star Schema.
* Experience with data governance, data quality, metadata, lineage, security and access management.
* Strong working knowledge of Git, CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Experience in data-platform modernization and migration.
* Strong architecture, problem-solving, stakeholder-management and technical-leadership skills.

**Certifications / Databricks Recognition**

* Databricks Champion recognition
* Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional.
* Databricks AI certifications.
* Azure Platform Architect accreditation or equivalent Databricks architecture credentials would be an advantage.
* Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering enterprise-grade Databricks solutions is essential.

title: Windchill Security Architect
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.
  
  
Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.
  
  
Role and Job Description for Security Architect :-
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced Security Architect with 15+ years of expertise in secure software development, application security, and enterprise security architecture. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to engineering leadership and business stakeholders, providing strategic guidance on security initiatives and best practices.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in software development and application security, with a strong focus on designing, developing, and implementing scalable security solutions that enhance the security posture of applications and platforms.
  
  
This role is responsible for identifying and driving scalable product security solutions to address application security risks. The candidate will work closely with Product Management, Development, and Application Security teams to identify security gaps, define remediation strategies, Identify and Develop practical and reusable security solutions with hands on working that can be adopted across engineering organizations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert with deep hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Cloud-Native Architectures, Application Security, Container Security, Identity & Access Management (IAM), and Secure Software Development.
* Analyse and assess security issues identified through threat modelling, security architecture reviews, secure development pattern assessments, security scanning tools, and customer-reported cases, and evaluate their security impact/ Risk on application security.
* Collaborate closely with Product Management, Development, Application Security, and Platform Engineering teams to design and deliver effective solutions with actual hands on, including reusable security frameworks, reference architectures, and remediation guidance that can be leveraged across engineering organizations.
* Drive the adoption of security best practices and secure design patterns across products and platforms to strengthen the overall security posture.
* Leverage 15+ years of hands-on software development experience, with deep expertise in Java and enterprise application development, to design and deliver large-scale, mission-critical software solutions.
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in modern application development and architecture, with extensive experience in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, Distributed Systems, and Cloud-Native technologies.
* Apply strong software engineering fundamentals, including object-oriented design, software architecture, design patterns, secure coding practices, and modern development frameworks such as .NET, Python, JavaScript, React, Angular, and Node.js.

**Your Team**
You will be part of the PLM R&D – Platform organization.
  
  
**Must-Have Skills**

* 15+ years of hands-on experience in application development and architecture, with deep expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, Distributed Systems, and Cloud-Native technologies.
* Application Security & Cloud Security: Strong understanding of Application Security standards and frameworks, Secure SDLC, OWASP Top 10, OWASP ASVS, Secure Coding Practices, Threat Modeling, Secure Design Reviews, Vulnerability Management, API Security, Penetration Testing, and security testing methodologies including SAST, DAST, IAST, and SCA.
* Identity & Access Management (IAM): OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, LDAP, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and Privileged Access Management (PAM).
* Strong hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing scalable security architectures, frameworks, and reusable security solutions across enterprise applications, platforms, and cloud-native environments

**Required Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related discipline.

title: Data Architect
description:
**The Role**
We are building our enterprise data platform from the ground up and need a Data Architect to own it. This is a greenfield, hands-on leadership role — not a consulting engagement. You will define the architecture, make the
  
technology decisions, build the foundation, and be accountable for outcomes. You will report directly to the CTO and
  
partner closely with a Senior Data Engineer on the same hiring cycle. The platform will serve business analytics, operational reporting, and AI-driven capabilities across multiple markets andenterprise clients. A key deliverable is enabling AI applications and agents to consume trusted enterprise data securely viaAPIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  
  
**What You Will Own**
Data platform architecture — Data Lake, Lakehouse, semantic layers, and data consumption patterns across
  
structured, semi-structured, and event-based sources.
  
Ingestion and transformation pipelines — batch, streaming, and CDC-based, with proper orchestration, observability, and failure handling.
  
Data modelling — scalable analytical models covering core business domains: orders, inventory, fulfilment,
  
logistics, marketplaces, billing, and platform performance.
  
Business analytics — governed KPI definitions, dashboards, and self-service capabilities that replace manual
  
reporting.
  
AI data enablement — architecture for exposing authoritative, governed data to AI agents through MCP and APIs, with appropriate access controls and tenant isolation.
  
Data governance and compliance — data quality, lineage, PII classification, and controls that meet enterprise
  
security and privacy obligations across multiple jurisdictions.
  
Platform reliability — monitoring, SLAs, incident management, and operational runbooks so the platform runs as a
  
production service.
  
  
**What We Expect**
First 90 days: Weeks 1–4: Assess the data landscape, produce an enterprise architecture proposal.
  
Weeks 5–8: Deliver the first production pipeline and a priority BI dashboard.
  
Weeks 9–12: Define common KPI models for two business domains and deliver the first MCP-based data capability for an AI agent.
  
6–12 months: Production data platform operational with automated pipelines for priority datasets.
  
Governed business models and trusted KPI definitions in active use by the business.
  
Dashboards live and replacing manual reporting. Architecture for secure AI data consumption implemented, with initial MCP capabilities in production.
  
Platform operational practices — quality, lineage, monitoring, cost controls — established and running.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**
10+ years across data engineering, data platforms, or data architecture — with real architecture ownership, not just
  
delivery.
  
Proven experience designing and building enterprise Data Lake, Warehouse, or Lakehouse platforms.
  
Strong SQL, data modelling, pipeline design, and cloud-native (preferably AWS) skills.
  
Experience with governance, data quality, lineage, and compliance — including PII and privacy controls.
  
Hands-on enough to validate designs and build in the early phase; structured enough to define standards that
  
scale.
  
Experience in eCommerce, logistics, marketplace, or B2B SaaS is strongly preferred — the domain is complex and
  
ramp time matters.
  
  
**Desirable:**
Practical experience with MCP, LLM/AI integration, semantic layers, RAG, or secure enterprise data access for AI systems.
  
**The Opportunity**
This is a founding role. The data platform does not yet exist. You will define what good looks like at Anchanto — and build
  
it.
  
If you are energised by greenfield architecture, comfortable with high ownership, and capable of moving fluently from
  
business question to data pipeline to AI consumption — we want to talk.
  
  
  
Benefits
  
  
  
**Why Join Anchanto**
  
  
  

At Anchanto, we believe in creating an environment where people can build meaningful careers, continuously develop their capabilities and gain exposure to a truly global business.

* **Global Exposure:**
  Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment.
* **Learning & Development:**
  We invest in our people through sponsored learning, certifications and development opportunities aligned with your professional growth.
* **International & Onsite Opportunities:**
  Client-facing roles may offer opportunities to travel and work onsite with customers across our global markets.
* **Medical Insurance:**
  Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to support you & your families health and well-being.
* **Comprehensive Leave Benefits:**
  Maternity, Paternity, Marriage and Bereavement leave, along with Comp Off and flexibility to support important personal commitments.
* **Recognition for Long-Term Contribution:**
  Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution.
* **Flexibility & Work-Life Balance:**
  A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities.
* **Meaningful Career Growth:**
  Take ownership of challenging, high-impact work and contribute to products and solutions that serve global brands, retailers and logistics businesses.

description:
We are looking for a Software Solutions Engineer to support NVIDIA AI Enterprise customers and deployments across cloud and datacenter environments. This is a dual role: (1) Support, triage and resolve complex customer software issues end-to-end, and (2) build software features, automation, diagnostics, reproducible test cases, and deployment tooling—to improve product readiness and scale support across enterprise environments.
  
  
You will work across compute and cloud-native technologies in CSP environments, including container platforms/orchestrators, enterprise system software, and GPU-accelerated AI frameworks and inference services used to run production AI workloads at scale. In this customer-facing role, you will work closely with customers and internal engineering teams to understand issues, explain root causes, drive resolution, and collaborate on fixes and improvements. Success in this role requires strong debugging skills, crisp communication, and ownership of technically deep escalations from inception to closure.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Develop and maintain product-facing features and deployment assets for AI Enterprise supportability (e.g., scripts, configuration guidance, Kubernetes manifests/Helm charts, and reproducible test cases)
* Develop and maintain Python-based tooling/automation (validators, log collectors, repro harnesses) to improve NVIDIA AI Enterprise deployment reliability across NGC and container orchestrators (e.g., Kubernetes)
* Contribute code-level fixes, patches, or pull requests (as appropriate) in collaboration with engineering to address customer-impacting issues and improve product readiness
* Support enterprise customers deploying NVIDIA AI Enterprise in datacenter and CSP environments, including Kubernetes-based and containerized production AI platforms
* Take ownership of customer issues from inception to resolution: reproduce in lab/cloud, collect diagnostics, provide mitigations, and partner with engineering on fixes
* Create high-quality bug reports and RFEs with clear repro steps, environment details (CSP/Kubernetes/GPU), impact analysis, and supporting artifacts
* Develop customer-facing and internal documentation (KBs, runbooks, deployment guidance) to improve time-to-value and reduce recurring issues
* Be on call one weekend per month in the event a customer has a Sev1 outage and requires engineering assistance

**What We Need To See**

* BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* At least 5+ years system software development and troubleshooting experience, ideally with some customer facing
* Strong computer science fundamentals and programming/scripting skills (Python required; Bash; Go/C++ a plus) to automate investigations and build diagnostics/repro tools
* Strong troubleshooting fundamentals (networking, concurrency, OS concepts) and a structured approach to isolating issues across application, platform, and infrastructure layers
* Deep understanding of at least two of the following: data centers/servers, distributed systems, virtualization, deep learning frameworks, containers (Docker/Kubernetes), hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD for reliable deployments
* Familiarity with GPU-accelerated AI/ML stacks and production model deployment/serving (e.g., NGC containers, CUDA/tooling concepts, inference serving such as Triton or similar)
* Deep Linux knowledge and comfort troubleshooting in production Linux environments; working knowledge of Windows is a plus
* Professional-level communication skills, interpersonal skills with a passion to solve problems

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Hands-on experience deploying and operating NVIDIA AI Enterprise components in production across on-prem or CSP environments
* Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants/tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) to accelerate debugging, automation, and test creation
* Experience operating Kubernetes-based platforms in production (cluster operations, upgrades, control-plane/data-plane failure modes)
* Strong performance debugging skills for GPU and cloud workloads (profiling, latency/throughput tuning) and familiarity with observability/tracing tools

title: BC Sector O And G-Cognite-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Cognite Solution Architect – Senior Manager**
**Experience Level - 15+**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Cognite Solution Architect to design industrial data solutions for upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations. You will define how operational, enterprise and engineering information is integrated, modelled and contextualized in Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), and how applications and analytical solutions consume that information. You will own solution architecture decisions, establish reusable implementation patterns and resolve complex technical issues across source systems, data models, access controls and consuming applications.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Architecture and integration**

* Translate operational use cases into data requirements, integration designs and application-consumption patterns.
* Define how CDF fits within historian, enterprise application, engineering information and cloud architectures.
* Select source-appropriate extractors, APIs and processing patterns, considering latency, throughput, connectivity and source-system load.
* Define historical loading, incremental extraction, reconciliation and recovery approaches, including late records, corrections and supported deletions.
* Establish requirements for service identities, access capabilities, environment separation, monitoring and operational support.

**Industrial information modelling**

* Design CDF models using spaces, containers, views and instances; select direct relations or edges according to relationship semantics and query requirements.
* Reuse and extend Cognite’s Core Data Model where suitable, introducing custom domain concepts where required.
* Define stable identifiers, source crosswalks and conflict-resolution rules, including repeated tag names across sites and systems.
* Represent physical equipment, functional locations and installation history separately where required.
* Establish schema versioning, migration and consumer-compatibility requirements while preserving lineage, timestamps, units, quality indicators and relationship provenance.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas semantics**

* Design relationships connecting equipment and assets with time series, maintenance records, documents and engineering diagrams.
* Define matching rules, confidence thresholds, exception handling and domain review for ambiguous associations; assess coverage and match accuracy separately.
* For upstream applications, model fields, wells, wellbores, production facilities, equipment, well tests and interventions, preserving distinctions between measured, calculated and allocated production.
* For downstream applications, model sites, process units, functional locations, equipment, laboratory results and maintenance activities, accounting for replacement, revisions and measurement timing.
* Validate that contextualized information supports the intended engineering workflow.
* Application enablement and technical assurance
* Define consumer data contracts covering entities, relationships, fields, freshness, permissions and query-performance expectations.
* Validate designs against representative Cognite applications, custom applications, and analytical or AI workflows.
* Develop critical prototypes and reference implementations using Python, SQL, Cognite SDKs and APIs.
* Establish deployment and environment-promotion practices using version control, automated validation and Cognite Toolkit.
* Review architecture changes, migration plans, integration code and performance bottlenecks; resolve cross-system design conflicts and mentor data engineering leads.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A relevant engineering, computer science or information systems degree, or equivalent technical experience.
* Demonstrated personal architectural contribution to a production Cognite Data Fusion implementation.
* Strong knowledge of CDF data modelling, transformations, contextualization and access controls.
* Substantial industrial data integration experience spanning representative operational, enterprise and engineering sources.
* Strong Python and SQL skills with practical Cognite SDK and REST API experience.
* Experience defining identity strategies, model evolution, deployment patterns and production support requirements.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture, identity providers, network boundaries and CI/CD.
* Strong Oil & Gas implementation experience in at least one upstream or downstream domain, with ability to adapt relevant concepts to the other.

**Good to Have**

* Cognite implementation experience across multiple assets or sites.
* Experience spanning both upstream and downstream.
* Familiarity with historians, maintenance systems, laboratory systems, engineering repositories or well-data services.
* Experience with diagram contextualization, 3D associations and industrial knowledge graphs.
* Experience enabling Cognite applications or AI workflows using contextualized data.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on architect who can defend consequential production Cognite decisions involving identity resolution, data-model design, access boundaries, recovery, schema migration and application compatibility, and demonstrate which patterns can be reused across sites and which require adaptation.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Platform Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Platform Architect
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
**Overview**
The Infrastructure Engineering team is looking for a Senior Platform Architect to lead the design and evolution of secure, scalable, and resilient enterprise infrastructure platforms that power Mastercard's critical business services. The ideal candidate is a strategic technology leader with deep expertise in enterprise architecture, infrastructure engineering, and cloud technologies. They are highly collaborative, intellectually curious, and passionate about solving complex technical challenges while driving innovation, operational excellence, and platform modernization. This individual excels at partnering across engineering, security, and product organizations to deliver scalable solutions that enable business growth and provide exceptional customer experiences.
  
  
Role
  
  

* Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of highly available, scalable, and secure enterprise infrastructure solutions across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.
* Partner with Engineering, Network, Security, Cloud, Database, Middleware, Product, and Program Management teams to develop infrastructure solutions that support business and technology strategies.
* Drive infrastructure solution delivery from initial business engagement through architecture reviews, financial approvals, procurement, implementation, operational readiness, and production deployment.
* Design resilient networking, application delivery, and security architectures utilizing enterprise technologies including load balancing, web application firewalls, API gateways, and distributed infrastructure platforms.
* Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives focused on automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), platform standardization, performance optimization, resiliency, and operational excellence.
* Develop enterprise architecture standards, technical roadmaps, and infrastructure documentation while mentoring engineering teams and promoting engineering best practices.
* Ensure infrastructure solutions meet stringent requirements for security, compliance, availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and performance across mission-critical platforms.

**All About You**
Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience
  
  

* Deep expertise in enterprise infrastructure architecture across data center, hybrid cloud, and distributed computing environments.
* Advanced knowledge of enterprise networking, application delivery, and infrastructure security, including Zero Trust principles and modern network architectures.
* Experience designing and supporting enterprise platforms utilizing VMware, cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), load balancing, web application firewalls, API gateways, and distributed infrastructure.
* Strong expertise in infrastructure automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible), CI/CD integration, and configuration management using tools such as Git, Bitbucket, and Jenkins.
* Demonstrated ability to architect and deliver highly available, resilient, and secure infrastructure solutions while collaborating effectively across cross-functional engineering and business teams.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence technical and executive stakeholders.

**Desirable Or Additional Capabilities**

* Expertise in infrastructure performance engineering, including capacity planning, scalability testing, and performance optimization.
* Advanced experience creating technical architecture documentation and executive presentations using Microsoft Visio.
* Experience supporting mission-critical financial services platforms with stringent availability, security, resiliency, and regulatory compliance requirements.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
FEQ327R324
  
  
As a Solutions Architect part of a Global Capability Center(GCC) focused Field Engineering team, you will shape the future of the Data and AI landscape by working with the most sophisticated Data and AI teams in the world, including Fortune 500 enterprises and global AI-forward SaaS customers operating globally. Reporting to the Field Engineering Manager, you will collaborate with our most strategic global prospects and customers, partner with regional field teams across geographies, work directly with product and engineering to drive the Databricks roadmap forward, and work with the broader customer-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform. You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.

* Be the trusted technical advisor for one or more named strategic accounts — building deep, durable relationships with their data, AI/ML, and platform engineering leaders, and earning a seat at the table for their most important architectural decisions.

* Coding experience in Python, SQL, Scala, Java, or R.
* Experience building distributed data systems at enterprise scale.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. It also means owning the commercial outcome of the technology business and deciding how the technology organisation should be structured as it grows. You will have the mandate to shape the team, the practices, and the technical standards we hold ourselves to.

title: Electronic Systems Technical Specialist - Software
description:
**Job Summary**
This applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and improves the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and negotiates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross-BU integration and coordination. Responsible for review of less-experienced developers/testers’ work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient designs. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across function(s) within a global business unit or managing improvement across business units. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.
  
  
**Competencies**
Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.
  
  
Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.
  
  
Product Platform Planning and Architecting - Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade-off analysis in collaboration with life-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.
  
  
Product Software Design and Construction - Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.
  
  
Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.
  
  
System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
  
  
Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.
  
  
Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.
  
  
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  
  
Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  
  
Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
  
  
Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.
  
  
Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.
  
  
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
**Experience**
Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred
  
  
**Role Overview**

title: Integration Principal (SQL Expert)
description:
**INTEGRATION PRINCIPAL**
(Pune)
  
  
*Founded in 2000, Ivalua is a leading global provider of cloud-based procurement solutions.*
**Company Overview**
At Ivalua we are a global community of exceptional professionals, who believe that digital transformation revolutionises supply chain sustainability and resiliency to unlock the power of supplier collaboration.
  
  
We achieve this through our leading cloud-based spend management platform that empowers hundreds of the world's most admired brands to effectively manage all categories of spend and all suppliers to increase profitability, improve ESG (environmental, social, and corporate governance) performance, lower risk, and improve productivity. Driven by our passions and fueled by our shared ambitions, we empower and challenge each other to create meaningful experiences for our colleagues, customers, partners, and communities.
  
  
Learn more at www.ivalua.com. Follow us on LinkedIn.
  
  
**THE OPPORTUNITY**
**Context**
You will be part of the Professional Services Team whose mission is to successfully deliver our unique and configurable solution to customers and support our Partner community with high quality standards and a strong commitment to excellence and efficiency. Our team is very hands-on with a strong mindset of problem-solving while also having the ability to think holistically and provide solutions that solve the customer's long-term challenges. The Data Intelligence division within this team focuses specifically on the pillars of system integrations, advanced Power BI reporting, and end-to-end spend management data solutions.
  
  
**Role**
We are seeking a highly technical, hands‑on, and detail‑oriented Principal Integration professional to lead the
**most complex, hands‑on integration designs and builds**
across our implementation portfolio. The ideal candidate is a senior individual contributor with a strong integration background and a proven track record of designing, implementing, and optimizing mission‑critical interfaces between cloud platforms and enterprise systems.
  
  
You will act as the go‑to integration expert across projects: owning design, build, troubleshooting and optimization for the most critical and technically ambiguous data flows, while setting standards that Senior Integration Leads and project teams execute against, and mentoring other team members (without direct line management).
  
  
This role is an individual contributor position, with significant autonomy and impact.
  
  
**What You Will Do With Us**
**Integration Design & Implementation**

* End‑to‑End Integration Design: Lead the detailed design of the most complex integrations between Ivalua and ERPs, HR, finance, logistics, and other third‑party systems, ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
* Hands‑On Build: Configure and develop integrations using Ivalua tools, APIs, ETL/EAI/middleware, file‑based interfaces and scripting where needed. Own technical implementation from design through deployment for the highest‑complexity streams.
* Standards & Reuse: Define, publish, and continuously refine integration standards, reusable patterns, and best practices (e.g., modular mappings, error handling, logging, versioning) for Senior Integration Leads and consultants to apply across projects.
* Performance & Robustness: Analyze and optimize integration performance (throughput, latency, data volumes), and design robust error handling, reconciliation and recovery strategies that serve as the reference approach for the broader team.
* Troubleshooting & Debugging: Act as the top‑level technical escalation point for integration‑related incidents that Senior Integration Leads and project teams cannot resolve, during build, SIT/UAT, go‑live and hypercare phases.

**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Work with Functional & Technical Teams: Collaborate closely with Functional Consultants, Solution Architects, Data Engineers and Project Managers to align integration design with business processes and data models.
* Customer Technical Workshops: Lead or co‑lead technical workshops with customers' IT and integration teams on the most strategically significant or technically ambiguous engagements, to capture integration requirements, present solution options, and validate technical designs.
* R&D Feedback: Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams on integration capabilities, feature gaps, and improvement opportunities encountered across the portfolio.
* Pre‑Sales Support: Provide technical input on the most complex or high‑risk proposals — contributing to solution design, effort estimation, and technical due diligence for prospective clients where deep integration expertise is needed to de‑risk the deal.

**Delivery Excellence**

* Technical Specifications: Produce high‑quality, reference‑standard technical design documents (integration specification, mapping documents, sequence diagrams) and keep them up to date.
* Quality Assurance: Define the org's unit, integration, and regression testing standards and frameworks, and perform peer reviews of integration designs and implementations across projects.
* Risk & Issue Management: Identify systemic integration risks (e.g., recurring dependencies, data quality patterns, performance constraints) and partner with project teams to define and drive mitigation plans at the practice level.
* Lifecycle Support: Support cutover planning, go‑live readiness, and post‑go‑live stabilization from an integration standpoint, including monitoring and early‑life support for the most critical engagements.

**Partner & Internal Enablement**

* Technical Mentor: Informally mentor and coach Senior Integration Leads and junior integration/technical consultants by sharing best practices, code samples, troubleshooting techniques and design approaches.
* Partner Guidance: Provide technical guidance to partners' integration consultants on specific projects, clarifying Ivalua integration patterns, constraints and recommended approaches.
* Knowledge Assets: Contribute to internal knowledge base articles, how‑to guides, reference implementations, and sample configurations to accelerate future projects.

**YOUR PROFILE**
If you have the below experience and strengths this role could be for you:
  
  
**Required Skills**

* Minimum 10 years of experience in technical integration, technical consulting, or web‑based software development, ideally in SaaS or complex enterprise environments.
* Significant hands‑on experience designing and implementing integrations using ETL/EAI or other integration/middleware technologies.
* Strong practical experience with SOAP and REST APIs, including API consumption, design principles, authentication methods, and error handling.
* Solid understanding of data transfer mechanisms (e.g., SFTP, FTPS, API‑based, file‑based) and data formats such as CSV, XML, JSON (experience with cXML/EDI a plus).
* Proficient with relational databases and SQL (e.g., SQL Server or equivalent): able to write and tune complex queries, perform data analysis, and investigate performance issues.
* Demonstrated ability to independently diagnose and resolve most the complex integration problems across applications, middleware, and databases.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with attention to data integrity, security and long‑term maintainability.
* Excellent communication skills, capable of explaining technical topics to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders, and leading technical working sessions with senior client and internal stakeholders. .
* Comfortable working in a customer‑facing Professional Services or consulting environment, managing multiple workstreams and priorities.
* A Bachelor's (BS) degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a closely related technical field or foreign equivalent is required.
* Ability and willingness to travel as needed (~10–20%, depending on project needs).

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in Procurement / Source‑to‑Pay (S2P), finance, or supply chain domains.
* Experience working with or alongside Systems Integrators (SIs) or consulting partners on integration topics.
* Exposure to cloud platforms and integration services (iPaaS, API gateways, message queues, event‑driven architectures).
* Familiarity with using automation or AI‑assisted tools for mapping, testing, or monitoring integrations.
* Relevant technical certifications in integration/middleware, cloud, or enterprise applications.

**What Happens Next**
If your application fits this specific position’s needs, our skilled Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial screening call. Get one step closer to achieving your goals – apply today!
  
  
Our Talent team will guide you through every step of the interview process - from preparation to completion. They're here to support you!
  
  
Our recruitment process is designed to assess your competencies through a series of personalised interviews with internal stakeholders relevant to the role.
  
  
Interviews will be conducted virtually via video or on-site with face-to-face meetings.

Collaborate with like-minded individuals who are deeply passionate and highly motivated about their work. Experience a truly diverse and inclusive work environment where your unique contributions are highly valued

United by our values we embrace diversity and equity in the broadest possible sense to create an inclusive workplace. title: Solution Architect Voice AI
description:
About AgentCallBack

AgentCallBack provides enterprise Voice AI agents that manage inbound and outbound customer conversations at scale. Our multilingual AI agents operate 24/7, handle natural interruptions, remember prior interactions, transfer calls to human agents and integrate with CRM, ERP, contact-centre and telephony platforms.

We serve customers across healthcare, insurance, financial services, hospitality, retail, property management and other service-based industries.

About the Role

We are seeking a technically strong and customer-focused Solution Architect to design and deliver enterprise Voice AI solutions.

You will work closely with customers, sales, product and engineering teams to understand business requirements, design solution architecture, manage integrations and guide implementations from discovery through production deployment.

The ideal candidate understands enterprise applications, APIs, cloud platforms, telephony and conversational AI, and can translate complex technical concepts into clear business solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead technical discovery sessions with customers and document business, integration, security and operational requirements.
* Design end-to-end Voice AI solutions covering telephony, conversation workflows, integrations, data flows, security and human-agent transfers.
* Create solution architecture diagrams, integration specifications, call flows and implementation plans.
* Design integrations with CRM and ERP platforms such as Salesforce, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, JD Edwards and GoHighLevel.
* Integrate AgentCallBack with contact-centre and telephony platforms such as Genesys Cloud, 3CX, Yeastar, SIP trunks and PBX systems.
* Work with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication frameworks, data files and middleware platforms.
* Convert customer use cases into structured AI conversation flows, including escalation rules, exception handling and compliance requirements.
* Support demonstrations, proposals, technical presentations and responses to RFPs.
* Define the scope, success criteria and technical requirements for pilots and proofs of concept.
* Coordinate with engineering and product teams to configure, test and deploy customer solutions.
* Lead user acceptance testing, production readiness reviews and technical handover.
* Diagnose integration, call-quality, latency and workflow issues during implementation.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for security, scalability, reliability and data privacy.
* Identify reusable solution patterns and contribute to implementation templates and technical documentation.
* Provide technical guidance to customers, implementation partners and internal teams.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 5–10 years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise integration, technical consulting or implementation.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication and enterprise data integration.
* Experience integrating CRM, ERP, contact-centre or customer-service applications.
* Working knowledge of SIP, VoIP, PBX systems, call routing and contact-centre technology.
* Experience designing cloud-based, scalable and secure enterprise solutions.
* Ability to create architecture diagrams, process flows, functional specifications and integration documents.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders and senior executives.
* Experience managing multiple customer implementations simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with conversational AI, Voice AI, speech recognition or generative AI solutions.
* Knowledge of large language models, prompt design, knowledge bases and conversational workflow development.
* Experience with platforms such as NetSuite, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, JD Edwards, Genesys Cloud, 3CX or GoHighLevel.
* Familiarity with AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
* Understanding of call recording, consent, Do Not Call requirements and data-protection regulations.
* Experience working with customers across multiple countries, languages and industries.
* Previous experience in a SaaS company, systems integrator or enterprise software consulting environment.

Key Competencies

* Customer-focused problem solving
* Solution and systems thinking
* Strong technical ownership
* Clear communication and presentation
* Attention to detail
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Ability to work in a fast-moving startup environment

Success in This Role

Success will be measured by:

* Quality and scalability of proposed solutions
* Speed and effectiveness of customer implementations
* Successful completion of pilots and production deployments
* Integration reliability and call-flow accuracy
* Customer satisfaction and adoption
* Clear documentation and effective knowledge transfer

Why Join AgentCallBack?

* Work on practical enterprise applications of Voice AI.
* Design solutions across telephony, AI, CRM and ERP technologies.
* Work directly with global customers and senior decision-makers.
* Influence product capabilities and implementation standards.
* Join a growing Singapore-based technology company serving international markets.

**Role overview**
:

We are hiring an SAP Pre-Sales Consultant / Solution Architect to win and shape SAP deals across AMS, upgrades and migrations, and to build Zensar's in-house SAP IP. The role sits in the SAP Practice Pre-Sales & COE team and works closely with SAP as our alliance partner.

**Purpose of the role:**

Convert SAP opportunities into winning, well-priced solutions; represent Zensar credibly to customers and SAP; and turn repeatable delivery know-how into reusable IP, accelerators and offerings.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. SAP alliance partnership

* Act as the practice's day-to-day point of contact with SAP partner, account and industry teams.
* Run joint go-to-market activity: co-selling, joint account plans, partner-led and SAP-led opportunity registration.
* Track and use SAP partner programmes (PartnerEdge, RISE with SAP, GROW with SAP, SAP BTP) and associated funding and incentives.
* Keep Zensar's partner credentials current: certified consultants, solution validations, and listings on SAP Store / Partner Finder.
* Bring SAP solution experts into customer pursuits when needed, and position Zensar for SAP-referred deals.

2. Solutioning and proposals – AMS, upgrade, migration

* **SAP AMS:**
  design support models (L1–L3), service catalogues, SLA/KPI frameworks, staffing pyramids, onshore–offshore mix and continuous-improvement levers.
* **Upgrades:**
  scope ECC EHP and S/4HANA version upgrades, including readiness checks, custom code remediation, testing and cutover approach.
* **Migrations:**
  shape ECC-to-S/4HANA conversions (brownfield, greenfield, selective/bluefield), RISE with SAP moves and cloud migrations to hyperscalers.
* Lead end-to-end response to RFIs, RFPs and proactive proposals: solution, effort estimate, resource plan, timeline, assumptions, risks and commercials.
* Work with Finance and Delivery on pricing models (T&M, fixed price, managed service, outcome-based) and margin targets.
* Maintain a reusable library of proposal content, case studies, estimation models and win themes.

3. Customer walkthroughs and orals

* Present solutions, demos and proposals to customer CXOs, IT heads and business users.
* Run discovery workshops, assessments and proof-of-concepts to sharpen scope.
* Lead orals, defence sessions and due-diligence calls through to contract.
* Ensure a clean handover of the won deal to Delivery, with scope, assumptions and risks documented.

4. IP and in-house solution building

* Identify repeatable patterns from AMS, upgrade and migration deals and turn them into IP.
* Build accelerators: migration and upgrade assessment tools, custom code analysers, test automation packs, AMS monitoring dashboards, and industry templates.
* Co-develop solutions on SAP BTP (extensions, integration, analytics, AI) with the COE team.
* Package IP into marketable offerings with collateral, demo environments and pricing.
* Explore listing suitable assets as SAP-validated solutions or on SAP Store with the alliance team.

5. Practice contribution

* Support account mining and pipeline growth with Sales and Account teams.
* Contribute to thought leadership: blogs, webinars, events and SAP partner forums.
* Mentor junior consultants and the intern pool on solutioning and presentation skills.

**Required skills and experience:**

* 10–15 years in SAP, with at least 4 years in pre-sales, solution architecture or bid management at an SAP partner or SI.
* Hands-on background in at least one SAP functional or technical area (FI/CO, SD/MM, PP/QM, Basis, ABAP, BTP).
* Proven track record of winning SAP AMS, upgrade and S/4HANA migration deals, including deals above USD 1 million TCV.
* Strong grasp of S/4HANA conversion approaches, RISE with SAP, SAP Activate methodology and SAP's cloud roadmap.
* Experience building effort estimates, resource pyramids and commercial models for managed services and projects.
* Working experience with SAP as an alliance partner: co-selling, deal registration and partner programmes.
* Excellent proposal writing and storytelling; confident presenting to CXO-level audiences.
* Ability to manage several pursuits at once under tight bid deadlines.

**Preferred qualification:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Computer Science; MBA preferred.
* SAP certifications such as S/4HANA (functional), SAP BTP, or SAP Activate Project Manager.
* RISE with SAP or SAP Cloud ALM exposure; hyperscale awareness (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Experience creating IP, accelerators or productized offerings and taking them to market.
* Industry depth in one or more of: manufacturing, retail, insurance, hi-tech, utilities.
* Experience with global customers across the US, UK, Europe or South Africa.

**Technology Consulting**
**Title: Application Engineer - III**
EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
  
  
Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**
Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
  
  
**The opportunity**
This role provides advanced-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases under general direction, and leads backend optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure, scalable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provides senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products.
* Translates technical specifications into code for complex new or enhancement projects for internal clients. Writes programs, develops code, tests artifacts, and produces reports. Employs software development techniques to ensure tests are implemented in a way that support automation.
