* Participates in design, code, and test inspections throughout the life cycle to identify issues. Explains technical considerations at related meetings, including those with internal clients. Performs systems analysis activities.
* Thoroughly understands client business functions and technology needs. Has a broad understanding of Vanguard's technologies, tools, and applications, including those that interface with business area and systems.
* Interfaces with cross functional team members, and communicates systems issues at the appropriate technical level for each audience.
* Thoroughly understands and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* Must Have skills : AWS Full stack Java required.
* Typescript

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back-end architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning.

title: Replication & Backup-Architecture & Design
description:
****Role Summary:****
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Enterprise DR Architect is responsible for designing, implementing, testing, and managing Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity solutions to ensure critical business services can be recovered within agreed Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
  
  
****RESPONSIBILITIES****

* Nutanix DR Architecture

The Architect shall perform the following activities aligned to the proposed DR solution and Client’s current set up:
  
  

* Validate DR design documentation provided by third-party implementation partner. Where needed create appropriate documentation as needed to implement and support the DR.
* Lead infrastructure recovery requirements.
* Propose recovery strategies against defined RTO and RPO objectives.
* Propose workload classification and grouping methodology
* Design disaster recovery sequencing and dependency mapping for infra and network layer. Provide guidance to the applications team wrt managing the sequencing and dependency mapping.
* Work with THIRD PARTY SUPPLIER to ensure that DR failover and failback approaches suits Client’s needs
* Prepare and produce appropriate DR runbooks, operational procedures and recovery documentation. Provide guidance and support the applications team to enable them crate runbooks, operational procedures and recovery documentation
* Provide risk-based recommendations and improvement opportunities.
* Define & produce relevant operational artefacts (e.g. a DR Operations Playbook) that cover end-to-end DR operational processes. Some of these processes include, but are not limited to - DR scenarios, DR triggers and its SOPs, Failover processes, Failback processes, frequent DR testing, end-to-end governance & monitoring.
* Technical Design (Nutanix DR Set-up)

**The Architect Shall:**

* Produce High-Level Designs (HLD) & Low-Level Designs (LLD) for implementations needed in Client’s environment.
* Validate High-Level Designs (HLD) & Low-Level Designs (LLD) provided by third-party implementation partner.
* Validate implementation plans submitted by third-party implementation partner.
* Produce operational readiness deliverables for current Client environment. Validate operational readiness deliverables from THIRD PARTY SUPPLIER
* Work with THIRD PARTY SUPPLIER and prepare test plans and acceptance criteria.
* Provide risk mitigation approaches.
* Produce infrastructure readiness requirements for current Client environment. Review infrastructure readiness requirements from THIRD PARTY SUPPLIER.
* Architecture Governance & Assurance

**The Solution Architect Shall:**

* Review overall Nutanix DR solution architecture proposed by third-party implementation partner.
* Review THIRD PARTY SUPPLIER solution’s architectural alignment with Client infrastructure, security and operational requirements. Where needed architect shall produce relevant architectures in consultation with THIRD PARTY SUPPLIER and current Client infra support teams.
* Ensure architectural completeness risks and dependencies.
* Design for workload protection coverage for server and VDI platforms.
* Work with THIRD PARTY SUPPLIER to design architecture against business continuity and resilience objectives.
* Ensure completeness of recovery scenarios, recovery dependencies and service recovery priorities.
* Ensure architecture scalability, maintainability and operational supportability.
* Stakeholder Co-ordination

The Architect, for the purpose of architecture reviews, requirement gathering, design clarifications and governance activities, shall coordinate and engage with:
  
  

* Client Infrastructure Manager and Project Manager
* Client BAU Support Team from Zensar
* Client Security Team
* THIRD PARTY SUPPLIER
* Testing Governance & Quality Assurance

**The Architect Shall:**

* Produce testing methodology along with THIRD PARTY SUPPLIER and Client teams.
* Produce DR testing scenarios and guide Client teams to produce relevant DR test cases
* Provide guidance during test execution.
* Validate test outcomes against agreed objectives.
* Provide architecture readiness recommendations.
* Operational Readiness & Handover Governance

**The Architect Shall:**

* Review operational handover documentation created and provided by third-party implementation partner. Where needed, architect shall produce relevant operational document covering end-to-end DR processes that needs to be signed off by Client stakeholders mentioned above.
* Review supports readiness.
* Ensure monitoring and operational support requirements and implemented and documented.
* Assess deployment readiness.
* Ensure the current Operation teams are provided all knowledge and artefacts to execute the DR processes.
* Provide architecture acceptance recommendations.

Final business acceptance and production approval wherever needed shall remain the responsibility of Client.
  
  

* Deliverables

The Nutanix DR Solution Architect shall provide the following deliverables: (Pls update this basis my comments above)
  
  

* Infrastructure Readiness Assessment for Nutanix DR.
* Architecture Gap Analysis
* DR Strategy Recommendations
* Test Readiness Review
* Operational Readiness Assessment
* Executive Steering Updates
* Architecture Sign-Off Recommendation
* Infrastructure Delivery Governance

To support the Nutanix DR implementation activities, involved Infrastructure DR Engineer (Nutanix / VMware / Windows) to execute infrastructure readiness, recovery planning and testing.
  
  
****QUALIFICATIONS****

* The Nutanix DR Solution Architect shall:
* Provide functional guidance and technical direction to the infrastructure support Engineer throughout the engagement.
* Coordinate, prioritize, track, and govern the execution of infrastructure-related activities required to support the Nutanix DR implementation.
* Review and monitor completion of infrastructure discovery, dependency assessment, and readiness activities.
* Govern the preparation of Nutanix, VMware, Windows Server, and associated infrastructure prerequisites required by the third-party implementation partner.
* Review infrastructure recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, and recovery runbooks prepared by the Infrastructure DR Engineer.
* Track readiness of core infrastructure services, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Authentication Services, File Services, and Infrastructure Management Systems.
* Govern and monitor infrastructure participation in replication, failover, failback, and recovery validation testing activities.
* Facilitate issue resolution, risk escalation, and stakeholder coordination related to infrastructure DR readiness.
* Review and report status, risks, dependencies, and delivery progress of infrastructure workstreams to Client project stakeholders.
* For clarity, the Infrastructure DR Engineer shall remain responsible for execution of assigned engineering activities, while the Nutanix DR Solution Architect shall provide governance, oversight, coordination, and technical assurance of the infrastructure workstream.
* The governance responsibility described above shall be limited to Zensar-assigned project resources only and shall not extend to the management, supervision, or governance of Client personnel, or any other customer-appointed third-party personnel.

**Ignite Your Future: Technical Leadership**

Join QAD, where we are redefining the supply chain through a single System of Action that connects people, processes, and data.

You will be the most senior technical voice across product pillars, setting the technical bar for the organization and influencing a large engineering community without needing a large reporting line. This is a deeply technical leadership role, not a people-management role.
  
  
**The Mission: Defining the Platform's Future**
You Will Set The Technical North Star For The Platform, Translate Company Strategy Into a Multi-year Architecture Roadmap, And Ensure Architectural Alignment Across All Product Pillars. **Your Impact: What You Will Be Doing**

* Cross-Functional & Executive Alignment: Partner with Product VPs, QA, DevOps/SRE and engineering leadership to secure alignment. Convey complex technical trade-offs to executives, customers and partners and drive consensus.

**Core Technical Foundations: What We Are Looking For**

* Architectural Depth: Deep knowledge of cloud-native systems, distributed computing, microservices, event-driven architectures and modern data architectures (SQL/NoSQL, streaming, lakehouse), sufficient to make high-stakes, long-term decisions.
* Applied AI Experience: Hands-on experience designing production GenAI or agentic systems: LLM orchestration, RAG, vector databases, evaluation pipelines and AI observability.
* Hands-on Technical Credibility: Strong foundations in data structures and algorithms, OOP and modern engineering practices, with working fluency in Java, Python, Scala, Go or Node.js and a recent history of hands-on design and code reviews.

* Measurable Outcomes: A track record of quantified impact: scale, uptime, latency, cost reduction or delivery-speed improvement.

* Strategic Thinker: Sees the big picture and the implications of technology choices, and can defend a position with data and sound judgment.
* Influencer Without Authority: Builds consensus across product and platform teams, mediates conflicts and moves large engineering groups in one direction.
* Adaptable & Innovative: Quickly assesses and adopts emerging technologies, particularly in AI, where they create competitive advantage.
* Proactive: Anticipates technical, organizational and business risks and needs without explicit direction.

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications**

* Degree: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience: 15+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in an architect or principal-level role (for example Chief Architect, Distinguished Engineer, Senior Principal Engineer, Head of Architecture or equivalent) at a product company, ideally SaaS.

You should have exceptional communication and analytical skills with the ability to communicate findings to clients and team members and the ability to manage and lead teams independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. Direct experience in MES Project Management, or MES Requirements Analysis or as a MES Solution Architect in discrete and process manufacturing is desirable. * Design and development of Integration with systems like Plant control systems, ERP, PLM, APS, and LIMS.

* Help implement and maintain processes for Master data setup for products and processes within Opcenter.
* Work with teams to deliver system solutions for customers and participate in the entire sales cycle from proposals, support through deployment of the customers solution.
* Contribute to the growth and development of Deloitte’s Siemens Manufacturing Execution System (MES) offering and provide market driven product requirements to internal teams.
* Assist project teams and business teams to verify the configurations/customizations during development, testing, and deployment phases to verify an end-to-end solution for our clients.

**Required Experience**

* 10+ years of hands-on experience on Siemens products - Opcenter Execution Core or Camstar and MOM Connect.
* Strong hands-on experience in configuration and customization of Opcenter Execution Core functionalities – Experience on modelling, Designer & Portal studio
* Experience of Mendix and Opcenter-Mendix integration
* Hands-on experience of developing interfaces using CN MOM / MOM Connect
* In-depth knowledge of ISA-95/S88 standards and their application in Opcenter MES design.
* Knowledge of GxP, GAMP, and 21 CFR Part 11 standards.
* Strong functional understanding of Level 3 and Level 4 systems, and familiarity with SAP-MES integration and Level 2 automation systems.
* Solid knowledge on BOM, Manufacturing Work Plans, MBOM and BOP is needed.
* Strong experience with Java and C# .NET, Oracle / SQL Database, and good working knowledge of Database like SQL Server & SQL Store Procedures.
* MES to ERP integration; Restful API and Webservices development experience.
* Familiar with Quality Management, Dispatch Management, Scheduling, WIP Tracking, Resource Tracking, Maintenance Management, etc.
* In touch with industry 4.0 trends, with emerging digital supply networks and exponential technologies, with industry automation tools and where the market and technology are pointing.
* Strong oral and written communication skills, including presentation and documentation skills (Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, etc.).
* Strong problem solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills with the ability to exercise mature judgment.
* Able to work independently and efficiently to meet deadlines, and multi-task multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Willingness to work in shifts to support different regions.

**Preferred**

* Experience in Siemens MES Global Manufacturing Suites, specifically Opcenter, APS, AIP, and Connect MOM.
* Exposure to Siemens products like DIS, Insights Hub, Opcenter Intelligence, APS is an advantage.
* Exposure to customization using Mendix is an advantage.
* Knowledge of MES Design, Development, Testing and Implementation processes.
* Experience in interface development.

**Qualifications Required**

* Undergraduate degree/Professional Degree, with First Class/Distinction in B Tech or B E
* MCA/M Tech/MSc

**How You’ll Grow**
At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer well-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. Saviynt Certifications (e.g., Saviynt IGA Professional, Saviynt Cloud PAM).

8+ years of IAM experience with at least 4+ years hands-on Saviynt experience.

* Proficiency with:

+ Directory services (AD, Azure AD)
+ Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
+ REST/SOAP APIs, SQL, JavaScript, JSON

* Experience implementing IGA, PAM, and access governance capabilities.
* Deep understanding of identity lifecycle management, RBAC/ABAC, SoD, and compliance frameworks.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience with SailPoint, Okta, or other IAM tools.

The Product Architect is responsible for defining and governing the end-to-end architecture strategy across cloud, data, AI/ML, and application platforms within a product or offering portfolio. This is an 8-10 year role based in India / USI.
  
  
This role operates at the intersection of business strategy and engineering execution, translating client and product objectives into scalable, secure, and compliant target-state architectures. The Product Architect ensures alignment with Deloitte engineering standards, DevSecOps practices, and industry regulatory requirements while enabling high-quality, enterprise-grade delivery. The role requires deep technical expertise, strong stakeholder management, and the ability to influence across product, engineering, security, and client leadership teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Architecture Strategy & Governance
  
  

* Define and maintain target-state architecture for products and platforms across cloud, AI, data, and application layers
* Develop architecture roadmaps aligned to product vision, client requirements, and market strategy
* Establish and enforce architecture standards, reference architectures, and design principles
* Lead architecture review boards and document technical decision records
* Ensure alignment with Deloitte technology risk, security, and compliance frameworks

Cloud & Application Architecture
  
  

* Design secure cloud landing zones (IAM, network segmentation, logging, monitoring, cost controls)
* Architect multi-tenant and single-tenant SaaS platforms
* Define scalable microservices, API-first, and event-driven architectures
* Ensure non-functional requirements (scalability, resilience, performance, availability, DR) are embedded early in design
* Provide hands-on architectural guidance for cloud-native implementations (AWS/Azure/GCP)

AI/ML & Data Architecture
  
  

* Architect end-to-end AI/ML solutions from ingestion and feature engineering to model deployment and monitoring
* Define MLOps standards (model registry, CI/CD integration, reproducibility, drift detection)
* Establish data architecture standards including modeling, lineage, governance, access control, and retention
* Implement RBAC and fine-grained security models across data and application layers
* Ensure AI solutions comply with responsible AI, privacy, and regulatory expectations

DevSecOps & Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Drive DevSecOps adoption including IaC, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and secure release practices
* Embed security controls (SAST/DAST, secrets management) into the SDLC
* Promote SRE and observability practices across product teams
* Identify and mitigate architectural risks, technical debt, and systemic dependencies

Stakeholder & Team Leadership
  
  

* Partner with Product Owners, Engineering Leads, Security, and Client stakeholders to resolve architectural trade-offs
* Communicate complex technical concepts to executive audiences and delivery teams
* Mentor engineers and junior architects to elevate architectural maturity
* Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, and client solutioning as required
* Support capability development within the practice through knowledge sharing and reusable assets

Reporting Relationships
  
  
Reports to the Product Engineering Leader / Offering Architect. Partners with Product Owners, Engineering Leads, Security, and Client stakeholders to resolve architectural trade-offs, and mentors engineers and junior architects across the practice.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 8-10 years of experience in software engineering and/or architecture roles
* Demonstrated experience delivering production-grade cloud-native solutions
* Strong expertise in distributed systems and enterprise application design
* Hands-on experience operationalizing AI/ML solutions and implementing MLOps
* Experience with enterprise data architecture and governance frameworks
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across product and delivery teams
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent

**Preferred**

* Deployment experience with GCP VertexAI / AWS Bedrock
* Cloud Architect certifications (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Experience working in regulated environments (Healthcare, Financial Services, Government)
* Exposure to Zero Trust security models and enterprise compliance frameworks
* Experience contributing to reusable accelerators, frameworks, or IP

Core Competencies
  
  
Technical Excellence
  
  

* Cloud architecture (IAM, networking, compute, storage, observability)
* Application architecture (microservices, APIs, integration patterns)
* AI/ML architecture and MLOps
* Data governance and RBAC
* DevSecOps and infrastructure as code

Leadership & Impact
  
  

* Influence without authority
* Executive-level communication and storytelling
* Risk identification and mitigation

* Structured problem-solving and decision-making

Collaboration & Market Impact
  
  

* Cross-functional collaboration
* Client-facing architectural advisory

Every product is only as strong as the architecture underneath it, and this role owns that foundation end-to-end. title: Solution Architect, Process Intelligence
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high\-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long\-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care.
   

  

 The Solution Architect, Process Intelligence is the senior technical owner of Edwards Lifesciences’ enterprise Process Intelligence capability on the Celonis platform. This role has end‑to‑end technical accountability across both Celonis platform pillars: Process Mining (data integration, object‑centric data models, analytical assets, and execution solutions) and Celonis Process Management (Process Designer, Navigator, and the governed process repository). The architect defines the event log architecture, ERP data extraction strategy, pipeline reliability, platform administration, and the technical standards that enable scalable, accurate, and audit‑ready process insights. While Order‑to‑Cash (O2C) is the initial scope, the architecture is designed to extend across additional enterprise process domains including Procure‑to‑Pay, manufacturing operations, and Idea‑to‑Market. This role acts as the primary knowledge transfer recipient from the Celonis SI engagement (896 hours, ending September 2026\) and serves as the India‑side technical leader for the BPM execution team. Upon SI handover, this role leads the maintenance, evolution, and scaling of the Celonis platform independently.
   

  

**How you’ll make an impact:**
* Define and maintain the enterprise event log architecture, object‑centric data models (OCDM), Perspectives, and Knowledge Model that enable process mining, conformance analysis, variant detection, and KPI measurement across enterprise processes. Own the technical design decisions that determine how business objects, events, and relationships are modeled within the platform (25%).
* Own the end‑to‑end data integration strategy from source ERP systems (Oracle JDE) into the Celonis platform, including connector configuration, extraction method selection (JDBC, REST, batch vs. real‑time), transformation scripts (PQL), data integration scheduling, and pipeline orchestration. Ensure stable, performant, and governed data flows that meet SLA requirements (20%).
* Serve as the technical owner of the Celonis Process Management (CPM) environment, including Process Designer, Navigator, and the enterprise process repository. Manage platform administration including SSO configuration, user roles and permissions, Home Site configuration, and release cycle governance. Ensure the CPM environment is operationally ready for enterprise‑scale BPMN modeling and process catalog consumption (15%).
* Serve as the primary technical counterpart to the Celonis SI team during the implementation engagement (May–September 2026\). Lead knowledge transfer activities across all SOW phases (Connect, Data Ready, Analyze, Execute, Handover) and ensure internal capability is built to sustain, operate, and evolve the platform independently post‑engagement. Shadow SI consultants during OCDM configuration, Studio asset development, and Action Flow design (15%).
* Establish and govern the data quality framework — including validation rules, reconciliation procedures, data scorecards, and root‑cause resolution workflows — to ensure mining outputs are accurate, consistent, and audit‑ready. Define acceptance criteria for event logs and analytical assets before publication to business stakeholders (10%).
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the Process Intelligence Data Engineer (P3\), Senior Analyst, Process Excellence (P3\), and broader Pune BPM execution team. Define technical standards, conduct architecture reviews, establish reusable templates and patterns, and ensure alignment with Edwards enterprise IT governance and security requirements (10%).
* Evaluate and recommend adoption paths for emerging Celonis capabilities (e.g., Process Sphere, Action Flows, AgentC, AI‑driven insights) aligned to Edwards’ process intelligence roadmap. Configure and validate execution solutions including Action Flows and Business Apps for prioritized value opportunities (5%).


**What you’ll need (Required):**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* 8\+ years of experience in data architecture, solution architecture, or analytics platform architecture roles.
* Hands‑on experience with the Celonis platform, including data integration, PQL (Process Query Language), object‑centric data modeling, and Studio asset development.
* Strong expertise in SQL, relational database design, and ERP data schemas (Oracle JDE, SAP, or equivalent).
* Experience designing and operating ETL/ELT data pipelines at enterprise scale.
* Demonstrated ability to define data governance frameworks, quality standards, and architectural documentation.
* Experience with platform administration including SSO, user provisioning, and role‑based access control.
* Ability to lead technical delivery in a global, matrixed organization and serve as a technical mentor for colleagues with less experience.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non‑technical audiences, including executive stakeholders.
* High level of independence, sound judgment, and ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, greenfield environments.


**What else we look for (Preferred):**
* Celonis certification(s) such as Celonis Data Engineer, Celonis Analyst, or Celonis Solution Architect.
* Experience with Celonis Process Management (CPM/Symbio), including Process Designer and Navigator.
* Experience implementing Celonis from greenfield (not just operating an existing deployment).
* Experience with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS) and modern data stack tooling.
* Python or other scripting language proficiency for data automation, validation, and pipeline orchestration.
* Experience operating in regulated industries (e.g., medical device, pharmaceuticals) requiring data integrity, audit readiness, and SOX compliance.
* Familiarity with BPMN 2\.0 process modeling standards and process excellence methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma).
* Experience with Action Flows, Business Apps, or similar execution/automation solutions within process mining platforms.

title: Architect - OT Security (Network Security)
description:
**About Position:** 




  





 We are seeking an experienced OT Security Architect with strong expertise in Operational Technology (OT), Industrial Control Systems (ICS), and Network Security to lead the design and implementation of secure, resilient, and compliant IT/OT/Cloud security architectures. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in protecting business\-critical operational environments by implementing Zero Trust principles, securing industrial networks, and ensuring compliance with industry standards such as IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIST, and ISO 27017\. This role requires deep technical expertise, architecture leadership, stakeholder engagement, and hands\-on experience in securing complex OT environments across energy, utilities, industrial automation, and cloud\-connected operational platforms.
 



  




* **Role: Architect \- OT Security (Network Security)**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 10 to 15 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**



  





**What You'll Do:** 




  




* Design and govern secure IT, OT, and cloud\-connected network architectures aligned with industry security standards and operational requirements.
* Develop and implement defense\-in\-depth security strategies for OT and ICS environments.
* Define network segmentation, VLANs, DMZ architectures, routing, switching, VPNs, and secure remote access controls.
* Lead Zero Trust security initiatives including ZTNA, MFA, PAM, and identity\-based access control implementation.
* Architect secure data flows between industrial systems, enterprise networks, cloud platforms, and remote operational environments.
* Design and implement secure cloud\-connected OT architectures leveraging AWS security services and controls.
* Establish architecture guardrails, security standards, hardening baselines, and implementation best practices.
* Conduct threat modeling, security assessments, risk reviews, and vulnerability management activities.
* Support compliance assessments against IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIST, ISO 27017, CRA, and customer\-specific requirements.
* Design and review industrial firewall, gateway, IDS/IPS, and network security solutions.
* Lead troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis for network security, segmentation, VPN, firewall, DNS, routing, and access\-related issues.
* Secure and assess industrial communication protocols such as Modbus TCP, DNP3, OPC UA, and MQTT.
* Drive SIEM integration, monitoring, alert investigation, incident response, and security operations readiness.
* Collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, operations, cybersecurity, and business stakeholders.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, architecture governance, and customer\-facing security consulting.
* Present security risks, mitigation plans, and architectural recommendations to leadership and clients.



  





**Expertise You'll Bring:** 




  




* 10 to 15 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Network Security, OT Security, or Security Architecture roles.
* Strong expertise in OT/ICS security architecture and industrial network security design.
* Extensive experience implementing IEC 62443 security frameworks and defense\-in\-depth architectures.
* Deep understanding of Purdue Model architecture and OT zone/conduit segmentation principles.
* Hands\-on experience with network technologies including VLANs, routing, switching, segmentation, VPNs, and DMZ architectures.
* Strong knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture, ZTNA, MFA, PAM, identity governance, and access security controls.
* Experience with industrial firewall and gateway solutions including Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, and Siemens Scalance.
* Expertise in IDS/IPS, SIEM integration, network monitoring, asset inventory, vulnerability management, and security operations.
* Strong knowledge of AWS security services including VPC, Security Groups, NACLs, WAF, private connectivity, logging, and monitoring.
* Experience designing and securing cloud\-connected OT and Industrial IoT environments.
* Knowledge of industrial communication protocols including Modbus TCP, DNP3, OPC UA, and MQTT.
* Experience conducting security assessments, risk analysis, compliance reviews, and remediation planning.
* Strong troubleshooting and debugging capabilities across OT, IT, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Experience supporting critical infrastructure, energy, utilities, renewable energy, SCADA, and industrial automation environments.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, consulting, and leadership skills.
* Ability to lead architecture reviews, security governance initiatives, and strategic transformation programs.



  





**Benefits:**

The role balances demand shaping and delivery execution with platform health, and represents the India team within Allianz Technology's global AI Factory leadership.
   

  

**What You Do**
* Lead and grow the India AI Factory team \- AI Engagement Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, and AI Platform Engineers and other AI roles \- setting priorities across concurrent OE engagements.
* Coach and develop team members; manage workload distribution, performance, hiring, and career growth across all three disciplines.
* Own the Factory's India delivery portfolio: sequence engagements, resolve cross\-team resource conflicts, and ensure reusable patterns (MVS, AI Building Blocks, platform capabilities) flow between projects.
* Act as the senior escalation point and relationship owner with OE leadership, Heads of IT, and Account Managers, unblocking engagements Engagement Managers cannot resolve alone.
* Own the India team's overall demand pipeline; prioritize opportunities, allocate Engagement Managers, and balance qualification, delivery, and run\-support work across concurrent engagements.

* Ensure the AI Platform Engineers' roadmap (runtime, governance, FinOps, observability) reflects needs surfaced by live engagements.
* Champion reuse: ensure Forward Deployed Engineers contribute new patterns back to the central building\-block catalogue and Engagement Managers factor reuse into scoping.
* Own the build\-to\-run handover model \- including support models, SLAs/OLAs, runbooks, and MLOps/monitoring \- and maintain oversight of security, compliance, and responsible\-AI standards across all Factory deliverables.
* Track Factory\-wide KPIs (time\-to\-value, reuse rate, delivery predictability, platform cost and reliability) and drive continuous improvement.


**What You Bring**
* Proven experience leading multi\-disciplinary technical teams (delivery/engagement, engineering, and platform functions) in large, matrix organizations, ideally in insurance or another regulated environment; knowledge of Allianz Group and Allianz Technology is a plus.
* People management track record: hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development across senior technical and delivery roles.
* Senior enough for OE leadership and Head of IT conversations, technical enough to challenge scope and platform decisions honestly.
* Strong stakeholder, business\-framing, and roadmap\-shaping skills, with the ability to prepare clear decision materials for executive audiences.
* Experience running a delivery portfolio: demand shaping, prioritization, resourcing, budget ownership, and risk management across concurrent engagements.
* An entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable taking ownership and driving topics forward in a build\-up environment without waiting for perfect structure.
* A degree in business, management, technology, or a related field.
* Fluent in English.


 Not Expected To Hands\-on Build Or Hold Formal Certifications (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman) \- Working Knowledge Of The Following Is Needed To Guide Trade\-offs, Hold Credible Technical Conversations With The Team, And Challenge Or Support Architectural And Platform Decisions
   

  

* Enterprise and solution architecture concepts \- technical blueprints, reusable solution frameworks, AI reference architectures, and integration standards.
* GenAI\-enabled capabilities such as intelligent assistants, copilots, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agents, and automation pipelines.
* Architecture patterns for multi\-system integration, API orchestration, and data harmonization.
* Cloud\-native platforms and services on at least one major hyperscaler (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* The modern AI/data stack \- vector databases, embedding stores, agentic frameworks, orchestration tools, and LLM/agent framework integration.
* AI governance and responsible\-AI principles, including model governance, data lineage, and auditability.
* Solution lifecycle management and reuse practices (MVS, AI Building Blocks) across sandbox, standardization, and retirement stages.


**What We Offer**
* We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in\-person collaboration and remote working, including up to 25 days per year working from abroad.
* We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes a company bonus scheme, pension, employee shares program and multiple employee discounts (details vary by location).
* From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered.
* Flexible working, health and wellbeing offers (including healthcare and parental leave benefits) support to balance family and career and help our people return from career breaks with experience that nothing else can teach.


**About Allianz Technology**
 With its headquarters in Munich, Germany, Allianz Technology is Allianz's global IT service provider and delivers IT solutions that drive the group's digitalization. With more than 11,000 employees in over 20 countries around the world, Allianz Technology is tasked with running, optimizing, transforming, and innovating the infrastructure, applications, and services together with Allianz companies to co\-create the best customer experience.
   

  

 We service the entire spectrum of digitalization, from one of the industry's largest IT infrastructure projects that spans data centres, networks, and security, to application platforms ranging from workplace services to digital interaction. In short: We deliver comprehensive end\-to\-end IT solutions for Allianz in the digital age. We are the backbone of Allianz. Find us at: www.linkedin.com/company/allianz\-technology.

 Allianz Technology is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment for everyone. We embrace individuals of all gender identities and expressions, sexual orientations, ethnicities, ages, nationalities, religions, disabilities, and philosophies of life. **Company Overview:** 
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. **Organization Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day\-to\-day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
   

  

 Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation, Synchrony's Engineering Team is the place to be.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 AVP, Solution Architect, seeking a Technology Lead/Senior Technical Business Analyst to drive partner onboarding success by leading cross\-shore teams focused on partner integration, testing, and resiliency. This role ensures integration environments are available and stable, and partners effectively with engineering, infrastructure, and product teams to execute strong change/release management and production readiness. You will troubleshoot integration issues end\-to\-end, perform root\-cause analysis using logs and data, and coordinate fixes with Agile delivery teams. The role also includes building and managing testing enablement capabilities such as mock data, test intake workflows, test data management, and communication plans to improve quality and speed. The ideal candidate brings deep experience with SOAP/REST web services, Java and database fundamentals, SQL/NoSQL technologies, CI/CD (e.g., Jenkins), cloud platforms (PCF/AWS), and monitoring tools like Splunk, along with strong Agile execution, stakeholder management, mentorship skills, and flexibility to support critical releases/incidents.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead multiple cross\-shore technology teams focused on partner integration, partner testing, and resiliency disciplines in partner onboarding process
* Influence and collaborate to ensure integration environment availability and effective change manage
* Analyze integration defects, troubleshoot systems, identify root cause and implement fixes in collaboration with other Agile build teams
* Develop and manage tools that facilitate testing, including but not limited to mock test data, testing intake requests, and communication plans
* Strong technical understanding of Java coding, Database structures, Log analysis, Infrastructure layer to support the partner onboarding process
* Mentor and influence up and down the chain of command
* Participate in Agile scrums with cross\-functional teams
* Participate in agile sprints including planning, daily standups, backlog grooming sessions and reviews
* Participate in the innovation workshop
* Participate in regular presentation and update on improvement process and client onboarding progress
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree and 10 years of technology experience or equivalent leadership program experience including 3\+ years experience on technical business analyst
* Critical Thinking and Creativity
* Excellence in communication with technical and non\-technical peers
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* 5\+ years of experience building and consuming web services via SOAP and REST
* 5\+ years of experience in SQL and NoSQL technologies, data modeling, query optimization, caching strategies, and transactional vs eventual consistency trade\-offs.
* Familiarity with Micro\-Frontends and front\-end platform governance is a plus.
* Strong understanding of SDLC (Agile), release/change management, incident management, and production readiness expectations.
* AI\-assisted development proficiency (e.g., GitHub Copilot/enterprise LLM tools) to accelerate design, coding, testing, and documentation—used responsibly with security, privacy, and IP considerations.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills; ability to lead cross\-team design discussions and drive alignment.
* Flexibility to support critical releases/incidents as needed.
* Deep Agile expertise
* Strong cross\-functional team player with the ability to work seamlessly across a matrix organization and partner with global development companies.
* Experience with continuous integration environments like Jenkins
* Experience building and deploying application on Pivotal Cloud Foundry, AWS, or other cloud environments
* Experience with test data management, test case coverage, and associated maintenance
* Experience using Splunk (or equivalent)
* Experience automation and innovation of easing business onboarding problems
* Ability and flexibility to travel for business as required


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree and 10 years of technology experience or equivalent leadership program experience including 3\+ years experience on technical business analyst


**Work Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony.  At

 , we partner with startups and innovators to turn raw ideas into working products—fast. Our projects typically move from idea to deployment in
 **2–6 months** 
 , starting with rapid discovery and moving quickly into execution.
 



 We’re looking for a
 **Technical Lead** 
 who combines
 **deep engineering fundamentals** 
 with
 **AI\-powered speed** 
 —someone who can design solid systems, make the right architectural trade\-offs, and still ship fast.

 .

 You

 Planisware Architect

Visit www.slb.com for more information.
   

  

 We are a global technology company driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. Together, we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. Our inclusive culture is the key to our success. We collaborate with our internal community of colleagues, alumni, and our valued external partners to support each other and achieve our goals. We look for people who are committed to innovation and success and act with integrity to become and be a part of one of the most diverse group of experts in our industry, anywhere around the globe. Global in outlook, and local in practice, we're united in our passion for discovering solutions and in our commitment to creating a sustainable and balanced future. We set the bar high. So we’re looking for talented, driven people committed to innovation and success and who act with integrity. We'll give you a platform to develop both professionally and personally, supported by our community of colleagues, co\-workers, alumni, and our valued external partners. It's a deep collaboration that enables us all to achieve our goals. Come and be part of one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive groups of industry experts.
   

  

**About SLB India Technology Center**
 SLB has embarked on a corporate transformation to deliver a step change in the reliability, efficiency and integration of our technologies, products and services. Advanced technologies are key enablers to this and encompass all aspects of business systems, including the organization platform and processes. Investments in, and building strong competences across our technology pillars – IT Central, SAP, Cyber Security, Digital Enterprise Systems, Data and Analytics, Digital Operations, Architecture and Integration, and Governance and Performance are key to an integrated digital that is positioned to deliver superior results. The SLB India Technology Center has a fundamental and critical role in this corporate transformation and for delivering digital solutions to the larger SLB organization.
   

  

**About Role**
 Slb has an opening in Coimbatore / Pune, India and Bogota, Columbia for a Technical Lead who will work on the Development / configuration for all modules / capabilities, changes and bug fixes related to Planisware and Microsoft .Net suite of applications in the Product and Service Delivery Function under Enterprise Solutions.
   

  

 The end users supported are the global community in Slb using these systems. Both L1 support and L2 support is provided in\-house while L3 Development and Support is outsourced to vendors.
   

  

 This role will work closely with the Scrum team on defining / change requirements and align with the development team (L3, vendors) for technical design and effort validation. Further, he/she will define periodic release plans and release schedules in coordination with the domain teams and the L3 vendor while being supervised by the Chief Scrum Master. He / she would manage the execution of release activities and co\-ordinate with the L3 development teams to ensure releases are delivered on time and within budget.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

 Technical Responsibilities
   

  

* Solution Design \& Architecture: Lead the design and architecture of standard as well as customized Planisware solution to address Project Management needs/Stakeholders
* Strategic Alignment: Work with product management and IT leadership to align Planisware functionality with business strategies and project goals.

title: Principal, Enterprise Arch
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

 The Principal Enterprise Architect is responsible for defining and advancing architecture for Global Engineering. The candidate will be a key member of the Global Engineering Architecture team whose collective responsibility is to enable system development through aligned enterprise strategies, roadmaps, golden paths, reference architectures, design patterns, standards, and governance frameworks. This role will partner with executives, enterprise architects, solution architects, application development teams, platform engineering, data, security, and the business. Must demonstrate a proven history of shaping large\-scale technology solutions that address the business objectives of a complex global organization. Ensures that business strategy, market trends, technology evolution, and AI\-enabled opportunities are effectively represented in the organization’s systems, platforms, data architecture, and business processes. Analyzes architectural requirements, defines the vision and target\-state architecture, assesses the current state, establishes transformation roadmaps, governs the project portfolio, and partners with solution architects and engineers to realize the target state.
   

  

 This individual must be delivery\-oriented, enterprise\-minded, and able to influence across senior business, technology, risk, security, and engineering audiences. Must be able to guide strategic direction and make pragmatic decisions that optimize business value, engineering velocity, resiliency, cost, security, regulatory expectations, and risk. Identify reusable platforms, shared engineering capabilities, overlapping functions, and opportunities to converge on standards in order to improve efficiency, quality, developer experience, and time to value across Global Engineering. The preferred candidate will have a broad background in enterprise architecture, application development, cloud\-native delivery, integration, data architecture, AI\-enabled solutions, platform engineering, security, and architecture governance. Must be able to work independently to solve complex problems, create and manage technology roadmaps, and collaborate effectively with a diverse set of partners.
   

  

**Knowledge / Skills**
* Previous or current hands\-on software development experience using modern application development frameworks such as Java/Spring, JavaScript/ReactJS, APIs, cloud\-native services, and engineering automation.
* Significant experience with enterprise architecture patterns, architecture governance, capability modeling, target\-state definition, and enterprise architecture best practices.
* Hands on experience designing and building of cloud\-native architectures; preference using Azure, AWS, Tanzu, and/or Kubernetes
* Deep knowledge of API and microservice style architectures
* Experience shaping AI\-enabled architecture strategies, including generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, model lifecycle management, prompt and context engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, and integration of AI capabilities into enterprise platforms.
* Strong understanding of responsible AI, AI risk management, model governance, explainability, data privacy, security controls, regulatory considerations, and production observability for AI\-enabled systems.
* Experience using API Management Platforms and Storefronts (e.g. APIGEE, Software AG, etc)
* Experience using Kafka, Solace, and/or MQ for messaging/event streaming
* Deep knowledge of architecture frameworks such as TOGAF and/or Zachman, with the ability to apply frameworks pragmatically across business, application, data, technology, security, cloud, and AI architecture domains.
* Experience with SQL, NoSQL, data platforms, metadata, data quality, lineage, and governance capabilities required to support analytics, AI, and enterprise\-scale decisioning; e.g. Oracle, Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, Mongo, data lakehouse, and cloud data services.
* Knowledge of software development methodologies and tools such as Agile, product\-oriented delivery, Github, GH Copilot, ADO Boards, Maven/Gradle, CI/CD (Actions), MLOps, LLMOps, and architecture\-as\-code practices.
* Experience with DevOps best practices and toolchain / pipeline automation, Azure DevOps and Atlassian Suite preferred
* Knowledge of the financial services industry and in particular, a broad and deep understanding of products and services provided by Northern Trust.
* Has an understanding of Global Engineering domains, enterprise platforms, software delivery practices, developer experience, cloud enablement, integration, data, security, and operational resiliency in a large financial services environment.
* Strong knowledge of security frameworks and controls.


**Major Duties**
* Define enterprise architecture strategies and target\-state roadmaps that provide business value while reducing complexity, technical debt, operational risk, and duplicated capabilities.
* Mediate conflicting priorities to drive optimal solutions.
* Identify and escalate duplication of effort, functional and technical redundancy, and opportunities to reuse Global Engineering platforms, standards, and shared enterprise capabilities.
* Create reference architectures and reusable patterns for common archetypes, including web, microservice, mobile, third\-party platforms, cloud\-native services, data platforms, AI\-enabled applications, and automation solutions.
* Quickly build proof of concept prototypes with new technologies being researched.
* Establish AI architecture guardrails, responsible AI design patterns, model governance expectations, data readiness criteria, and production readiness standards for AI\-enabled solutions.
* Partner with platform engineering, data, security, risk, and application teams to integrate AI capabilities safely into enterprise platforms and business processes.
* Enable the development organization by creating working examples
* Create cloud, platform, data, and AI\-related frameworks that embed non\-functional requirements, including resiliency, observability, security, privacy, performance, scalability, cost management, and operational supportability.
* Define cloud, platform engineering, DevSecOps, data, and AI delivery best practices for Global Engineering.
* Training technologists and provide project\-based consulting/expertise
* Liaise with Enterprise Architecture, Global Engineering, Security, Data, Risk, Infrastructure, and application delivery groups to align architecture direction and execution.
* Solve problems collaboratively.
* Act as a subject matter expert on technologies and trends in enterprise architecture, cloud, platform engineering, middleware, data, security, infrastructure, generative AI, and AI\-enabled automation.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum 12\+ years of technology experience across application development, engineering, architecture, platform, data, cloud, or related disciplines.
* Minimum 8\+ years of enterprise, solution, domain, or platform architecture experience, with demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and govern architecture decisions at scale.
* Demonstrated experience applying AI, data, automation, cloud, and platform architecture concepts to enterprise transformation, including responsible AI and AI governance considerations.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; MBA or Master’s degree preferred


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Pune Office**
 The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
   

  

 Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Principal Engineer, Real-time Payments (Technology & Architecture)
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Principal Engineer, Real\-time Payments (Technology \& Architecture)
   

  

 Principal Engineer, Real time Payments (Technology \& Architecture)
   

  

**Overview**
 The Real time Payments (RTP) program is driving the global shift toward instant, account to account payments, enabling secure, low latency, and highly resilient payment services across multiple live markets worldwide.
   

  

 RTP platforms operate as mission critical financial infrastructure, supporting high transaction volumes, strict regulatory expectations, and near zero downtime requirements. The program spans multiple products and shared services, deployed across diverse market and customer environments, while adhering to Mastercard’s enterprise architecture, security, and operational standards.
   

  

 Engineering within RTP is focused not only on feature delivery, but on building scalable, resilient platforms that can evolve safely over time—through strong architecture, disciplined engineering practices, and a relentless focus on non functional excellence.
   

  

 Role
   

  

 We are seeking a Principal Engineer to provide hands on technical execution and architecture \& technology leadership for multiple Real\-time Payments products and platform capabilities across multiple markets.
   

  

 This is a senior individual contributor role for a deeply experienced engineer who:
   

  

* Owns the design and implementation of complex services or subsystems
* Stays close to the code on complex and high risk areas
* Is deeply hands‑on and leads by technical design \& architecture excellence
* Contributes \& drives architecture and product design aspects
* Owns key technology \& implementation decisions including all non\-functional aspects across performance, scalability, reliability, security, and observability


 The role combines strong technical depth with engineering leadership with end‑to‑end ownership for delivery quality, correctness, and maintainability in their area of responsibility.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 The role spans five core dimensions, with ownership across end to end technical outcomes.
   

  

* Design \& Technical Execution
* Own the architecture and detailed design for one or more RTP products or platform capabilities across markets.
* Define and enforce reference architectures, design patterns, and engineering standards (e.g., microservices, event driven architecture, domain driven design).
* Design, build, and maintain high‑quality software components and services for RTP products.
* Lead and participate in technical design reviews, ensuring alignment with RTP and enterprise architecture principles.
* Make clear, well reasoned technology and design trade offs, balancing delivery speed, risk, and long term maintainability.
* Own end‑to‑end delivery of complex features or subsystems, from design through production.
* Translate functional and non‑functional requirements into robust technical implementations.
* Ensure solutions adhere to RTP architecture standards and engineering best practices.
* Hands‑on Engineering \& Code Quality
* Remain hands on for critical components, complex problem areas, prototypes, and reference implementations.
* Lead by example in code quality, testing discipline, and maintainable design.
* Perform and participate in code reviews, raising the bar for engineering quality.
* Drive high quality implementations for low latency, high throughput, distributed systems.
* Support teams in solving deep technical problems across application, messaging, data, and platform layers.
* Non Functional Excellence (NFR Ownership)
* Design and implement solutions that meet defined performance, scalability, reliability, and security requirements.
* Define and enforce measurable non functional requirements, SLIs, and SLOs.
* Ensure production readiness through strong observability (metrics, logs, traces), capacity planning, and failure mode design.
* Proactively identify and remediate architectural, capacity, and resilience risks.
* Support performance testing, capacity validation, and production readiness activities.
* Actively participate in incident analysis and remediation when issues arise.
* Cross Market Consistency \& Platform Evolution
* Drive cross market alignment, preventing architectural and Technology drift and duplicated solutions.
* Promote reuse of patterns, components, and learnings across RTP markets and shared services.
* Contribute to and influence the technology roadmap, including platform evergreening and technical debt reduction.
* Act as a trusted technical partner to product, operations, and governance forums.
* Engineering Leadership \& Bar Raising
* Mentor senior engineers and technical leads; raise the quality of design reviews, code reviews, and technical decision making.
* Influence engineering culture toward ownership, quality, and operational excellence.
* Support hiring and technical assessments, helping set the bar for senior technical talent.
* Communicate complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non technical stakeholders.


**All About You**
 Experience \& Technical Expertise
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, with significant time spent designing and building distributed systems at scale.
* Proven experience owning architecture and design for complex, business critical platforms.
* Strong hands on expertise with microservices and event driven architectures.
* Deep understanding of performance engineering, scalability patterns, resilience design, and failure handling.
* Solid experience with observability, production diagnostics, and operational readiness.


 Technology Breadth
   

  

* Strong background in enterprise backend development with hands\-on experience across object\-oriented \& functional programming languages \- Java/Spring, React, Angular, Erlang
* Experience working across multiple technology stacks and system layers (application, messaging, data, platform).
* Familiarity with cloud and containerized environments; ability to operate effectively across heterogeneous market deployments.
* Payments or financial services experience (e.g., real time processing, regulated environments) is a strong plus.


 Leadership \& Ways of Working
   

  

* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and lead through technical credibility.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and making high impact technical decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
* A mindset focused on long term platform health, not just short term delivery.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking experienced and hands\-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
   

  

 The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python\-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost\-awareness, and delivery quality.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
* Architect and operate production\-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self\-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
* Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform — module design, remote state, workspaces, policy\-as\-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
* Build, maintain, and optimize end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
* Develop Python\-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day\-2 operations across cloud platforms.
* Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy\-as\-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
* Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
* Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
* Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost\-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
* Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 6\+ years of overall experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, or platform engineering, with at least 3\+ years in a senior or lead capacity.

* Deep, production\-grade experience with Kubernetes and the broader container ecosystem (Docker, Helm, Istio / service mesh, ingress controllers, operators).
* Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi\-environment patterns, and integration with policy\-as\-code frameworks.

**About The Job**
 The Globalization Experience Team is searching for an Internationalization Software Engineer responsible for creating, enhancing, and maintaining robust software and tooling so SAS products work correctly for global users across languages, locales, and character sets. This role focuses on building and integrating foundational internationalization capabilities—Unicode correctness, locale‑sensitive formatting and sorting, and string externalization/resource management—while partnering with product teams to embed best practices early in the software development cycle. You’ll also use AI\-assisted techniques (when appropriate) to accelerate analysis, automation, and documentation, helping teams deliver global\-ready software efficiently and consistently.

* Partner closely with cross‑functional stakeholders—including product development teams, product managers, project managers, support engineers, and testers—to integrate internationalization best practices early and throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Collaborate with internationalization testers to guide testing strategies, investigate defects, and drive engineering improvements that result in high‑quality, globally usable product deliverables.

**Required Qualifications**

* Proficiency in one or more of the following programming languages: Go, Python, and C, with the ability to read, understand, and contribute to production codebases.
* Working proficiency in shell scripting (e.g., Bash or similar) to support automation, tooling, or development workflows.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross‑functional teams including developers, testers, and product stakeholders.

* Experience using Jira and Confluence as part of an Agile development process, including issue tracking, planning, and documentation.
* Ability to adjust working hours to accommodate a variety of time zones

**Additional Competencies, Knowledge And Skills**
* Experience with SAS programming or familiarity with SAS language, tools, or development environments.

**Job Description**
**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Salesforce Technical Architect to lead the design, development, and delivery of enterprise\-grade Salesforce implementations and integrations. This role requires an experienced professional who can partner with project managers, developers, and client stakeholders to architect scalable and sustainable technicalsolutions. The ideal candidate will be a trusted advisorto clients, capable of translating business needs into actionable technical strategies, and driving innovation while ensuring adherence to best practices.
   

  

 This is a leadership role that requires strategic thinking, technical expertise, and the ability to influence stakeholders. The Technical Architect will be responsible for overseeing technical teams, guiding design decisions, and ensuring that solutions align with both immediate requirements and long\-term business goals.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Serve as the technical expert and advisor for Salesforce implementations, providing strategic guidance to clients and internal teams.
* Design and deliver scalable and secure Salesforce architectures for complex, enterprise\-level requirements.
* Lead technical discussions with clients to understand their business challenges and translate them into comprehensive technical solutions.
* Recommend the best technicalsolutionsfor given requirements, clearly articulating trade\-offs and considerations for scalability, performance, and maintainability.
* Develop robust integration frameworks to connect Salesforce with other enterprise systems, ensuring seamless data flow and operational efficiency.
* Create governance models, enforce development operations best practices, and ensure compliance with security standards.
* Build proofs\-of\-concept (POCs) and prototypes to validate technical feasibility and provide guidance to development teams.
* Monitor and mitigate technical risks, ensuring the delivery of high\-quality solutions within defined timelines.


**Key Skills And Expertise**
* Strong strategic thinking and problem\-solving skills with the ability to see the “big picture”.
* Expert\-level knowledge of Salesforce architecture and development, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and other Salesforce platforms.
* Proficiency in integrating Salesforce with third\-party technologies such as ERP systems (e.g., SAP), marketing platforms (e.g., Pardot), and analytics tools (e.g., Einstein Analytics).
* Advanced knowledge of data architecture, APIs, middleware, and integration patterns.
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce development tools,such as Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, and the Salesforce CLI.
* Strong leadership and collaboration skills, with experience managing diverse teams across geographies and cultures.
* Excellent listening, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, version control, and automated testing frameworks.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools.


**What You’ll Do**
* Collaborate with clients to understand their business requirements and technical needs through discovery sessions and workshops.
* Develop and manage comprehensive technical roadmaps to optimize revenue generation processes, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
* Architect and oversee the development of processes, automations, and dashboards in Salesforce and connected systems, ensuring scalability and flexibility.
* Guide project planning, documentation, testing, and deployment activities, ensuring seamless delivery of solutions.
* Conduct code reviews and provide mentorship to development teams, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
* Proactively identify opportunitiesforinnovation and optimization, driving value for clients through enhanced Salesforce capabilities.
* Ensure alignment with industry standards, Salesforce best practices, and emerging trends in CRM technology.

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 AI Architect\- SC products: We are seeking an experienced Supply Chain AI Solution Architect to join our Digital Supply Chain Team. This hybrid role combines enterprise AI architecture, Supply Chain taxonomies and knowledge graph, product thinking, and client advisory to translate business needs into secure, scalable solutions that deliver measurable value.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement advanced prompting, context engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and memory management strategies.

* Define AI security architectures addressing prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized tool access, jailbreak attempts, and AI\-specific threats.
